request: a new graph please: a section called "Events by kind" and the small note "all time" that contains a breakdown of event by kind showing how many there are right after the "Coming up" section, not urgent
program_before:
app "Shaadi Catering" gift plum
table event client text, date date, guests num 20..2000 = 200, rate money, advance money = 0, kind pick Wedding|Walima|Mehndi|Birthday|Corporate = Wedding
setting heads num = 800 "Guests I can serve a week"
let total = sum(event, it.guests * it.rate)
let balance = sum(event where date >= today, it.guests * it.rate - it.advance)
topbar event, "Book event"
statcard balance, "still to collect from" count(event where date >= today) "events"
row gap 2
  stat count(event where date >= today and date <= today + 7), "events this week"
  stat sum(event.guests where date >= today and date <= today + 7), "guests this week"
  stat sum(event.advance where date >= today), "advance held"
goal sum(event.guests where date >= today and date <= today + 7), heads, "of weekly capacity", "guests"
section "Coming up", "nearest first"
  each event where date >= today sort date top 6 as e empty "No upcoming events. Add the next booking."
    row card gap 2 tap edit e swipe remove e
      stack grow gap 0
        e.client e.kind bold
        e.date "-" e.guests "guests" faint
      stack gap 0 align end
        e.guests * e.rate - e.advance bold
        "balance" tiny faint
section "Revenue per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(event month of it, it.guests * it.rate), monthname(it)
section "Booked value", "all events"
  stat total, "total booked"
section "Guests per kind", "upcoming"
  each options event.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) / max(sum(event.guests where date >= today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each event top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.client bold
        x.kind x.date faint
      x.guests "guests" bold

request: give the screen a card with a big number for how many reading entries there are this week and the caption "entries this week" above the "entries last week" stat
program_before:
app "Electricity" bolt orange
table reading units num 0..99999 unit "units", note text?
table bill month_name text, amount money
setting rate money = 42 "Price per unit"
setting limit num = 300 "Units I want to stay under"
let used = last(reading.units) - first(reading.units month)
let est = used * rate
topbar reading, "Add reading"
statcard max(used, 0), "units used this month, limit" limit, limit
row gap 2
  statcard round(est), "estimated bill so far"
  statcard max(round(used / max(monthday(today), 1) * 10) / 10, 0), "units per day"
if used > limit
  "You are over your limit. Switch off the standby devices." color warn bold
section "Meter readings", "last 30 days"
  trend reading last 30 days, it.units
section "Projection", "if you keep this pace"
  round(max(used, 0) / max(monthday(today), 1) * monthdays(today)) big
  "units by the end of the month" faint
section "Paid bills", "last 6"
  bars bill top 6, it.amount, it.month_name
section "Add a bill"
  form bill, "Save bill"
section "Cost per unit", "from paid bills"
  round(sum(bill.amount) / max(count(bill), 1)) big
  "average bill" faint
section "Readings"
  list reading by day, "No readings yet. Read the meter on the first of each month."
row gap 2
  statcard count(reading prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(reading) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(reading year) faint
  "Last one" since(reading) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(reading where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(reading on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(reading.units) * 10) / 10 "units" big
  "Highest" max(reading.units) "units" faint
  "Lowest" min(reading.units) "units" faint

state sh pick Morning|Evening = Morning
let today_l = sum(milk.litres today)

section "Shift view"
  choice sh

    row gap 2
      c bold grow

  share milk month by cow, sum(it.litres), it.key

section "Evening against morning", "this week"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres week where shift = Morning), "L morning"

section "Best day this month", "litres"
  stat max(days month, sum(milk.litres on it)), "L in one day"
section "Month income", "at the price per litre"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres month) * price, "earned"

      sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) / max(sum(milk.litres week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if today_l >= goal

table usage kid pick Ayan|Hira = Ayan, mins num 5..600 unit "min", kind pick Games|Videos|School|Chat = Videos
setting limit num = 90 "Daily limit per child (min)"
let total = sum(usage.mins today)
let ok_days = count(days last 14 days, sum(usage.mins on it) <= limit * 2)
topbar usage, "Log time"
statcard total, "min of screen time today, all kids", limit * 2
section "Each child today", "limit" limit "min"
  each options usage.kid as k
    stack gap 0
      row
        k grow
        sum(usage.mins today where kid = k) "min" bold color if(sum(usage.mins today where kid = k) > limit, bad, ink)
      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(usage.mins today where kid = k) / limit, 0, 1), 4 fill if(sum(usage.mins today where kid = k) > limit, warn, accent) radius 2
section "Family minutes per day", "limit for two kids"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(usage.mins on it), limit * 2
section "School time", "this week"
  sum(usage.mins week where kind = School) "min" big
  "Games and videos" sum(usage.mins week where kind = Games or kind = Videos) "min" faint
row gap 2
  statcard ok_days, "days inside limits, last 14", 14
  statcard round(sum(usage.mins last 7 days) / 7), "min a day on average"
section "Per child this week"
  each options usage.kid as k
    row gap 1
      k grow
      sum(usage.mins week where kid = k) "min" bold
      "of" limit * 7 faint
section "Longest session", "this month"
  max(usage.mins month) "min" big
  "Sessions this month" count(usage month) faint
section "Today's sessions"
  list usage today, "No screen time logged today. Log it after each session."
row gap 2
  statcard count(usage week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(usage prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(usage) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(usage year) faint
  "Last one" since(usage) "days ago" faint

app "Orchard" apple yellow

section "Crates per block", "against a third of target"
  each options picking.block as v
    row gap 2

        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(picking.crates where block = v) / max(target / 3, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each picking top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.block bold
        x.grade faint
      x.crates "crates" bold

app "Deploys" bolt slate dark
table deploy service pick Web|API|Worker|Docs = Web, version text, result pick Success|Rolled_back|Failed = Success, mins num 1..120 = 6 unit "min"
setting slow num = 15 "Slow deploy limit (min)"
let rate = round(count(deploy where result = Success) * 100 / max(count(deploy), 1))
topbar deploy, "Log deploy"
row gap 2
  stat rate, "percent succeeded"
  stat round(avg(deploy.mins)), "average minutes"
if count(deploy where mins > slow) > 0
  "Slow deploys:" count(deploy where mins > slow) "over" slow "minutes" color warn bold
section "Deploys per day", "last 14 days"

section "By service", "all time"

section "Duration", "last 14 days"
  trend deploy last 14 days sort at, it.mins
each deploy top 8 as d empty "No deploys logged yet. Log the next release."
  row card gap 2 tap edit d swipe remove d
    stack grow gap 0
      d.service d.version bold
      d.at faint
    d.mins "min" color if(d.mins > slow, warn, ink)
    d.result color if(d.result = Success, good, bad)
section "Failures", "last 30 days"
  daybars last 30 days, count(deploy on it where result != Success)
section "Slowest deploys", "top 3"
  each deploy sort mins desc top 3 as d empty "No deploys yet."

      d.mins "min" color warn

  list deploy where result = Rolled_back top 4, "No rollbacks. Keep it that way."
section "Results", "all deploys"
  each options deploy.result as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(deploy where result = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(deploy where result = v) / max(count(deploy), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Last deploy"

      d.service d.version bold grow
      d.result faint

request: Pls add a monthly reminder "School fee is due" on day 5 at 9:00, i will use it every day
program_before:
app "School fees" school blue
table payment child pick Ayan|Hira = Ayan, term pick Term_1|Term_2|Term_3 = Term_1, amount money, paid_on date = today, receipt text?
setting yearly_fee money = 240000 "Total fees for the year"
setting due_day num = 5 "Fees due on day of month"
let paid = sum(payment.amount year)
let left = max(yearly_fee - paid, 0)
topbar payment, "Add payment"
statcard paid, "paid this year of" yearly_fee, yearly_fee
row gap 2
  statcard left, "still to pay"
  statcard count(payment year), "payments made"
section "Per child", "this year"
  each options payment.child as c
    stack gap 0
      row
        c grow
        sum(payment.amount year where child = c) bold
      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * sum(payment.amount year where child = c) / max(paid, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Per term"
  share payment year by term, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Paid per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(payment.amount month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Biggest payment"
  max(payment.amount) big
  "Average payment" round(avg(payment.amount)) faint
section "Months left", "at the current pace"
  if(paid > 0, round(left / (paid / max(month(today), 1))), 0) big

app "Flags" flag plum dark
table flag name text, env pick Dev|Staging|Prod = Dev, owner pick Ali|Sara|Bilal|Hina = Ali, on bool
setting stale num = 30 "Stale after (days)"
let live = count(flag where env = Prod and on = yes)
let old = count(flag where on = yes and at < today - stale)
topbar flag, "Add flag"
row gap 2
  stat live, "on in production"
  stat count(flag where on = yes), "on anywhere"
  stat old, "stale and still on"
if old > 0
  "Clean up" plural(old, "flag") "older than" stale "days." color warn bold
grid 3 gap 1
  each options flag.env as e
    stack card gap 0
      e bold
      count(flag where env = e and on = yes) big
      "of" count(flag where env = e) faint
each flag sort env as f empty "No flags yet. Add the first one with Add flag."
  row card gap 2 tap edit f swipe remove f
    toggle f.on
    stack grow gap 0
      f.name bold
      f.env "-" f.owner faint
    if f.on = yes and f.at < today - stale
      "Stale" color warn bold
section "Flags per owner"
  share flag by owner, count(it), it.key
section "Created per week", "last 6 weeks"
  bars days last 6 weeks, count(flag week of it), monthday(it)
section "On by owner"
  each options flag.owner as o
    row gap 2
      o bold grow
      count(flag where owner = o and on = yes) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(flag where owner = o and on = yes) / max(count(flag where on = yes), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each flag top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        x.env faint
      x.owner bold

app "Vaccines" shield teal
table vaccine name text, child pick Ayan|Hira = Ayan, due date, clinic text?

topbar vaccine, "Add vaccine"
row gap 2
  statcard got, "of" total "vaccines given", total
  statcard soon, "due in the next 14 days"

  button "Everyone" fill if(who = All, accent, soft) tap set who = All

  each vaccine where who = All or child = who sort due as v empty "No vaccines yet. Add the ones on your child's card."
    row card gap 2 tap edit v swipe remove v
      stack grow gap 0
        v.name bold
        v.child v.clinic faint
        if count(v.given all) > 0
          "Given" color good small
        else
          if v.due < today
            "Overdue by" today - v.due "days" color bad small

      toggle v.given all

  each options vaccine.child as c

app "Birds" leaf green
table sighting species text, seen num 1..500 = 1, place pick Garden|Park|Lake|Hills|Farm = Garden, note text?

    row gap 2

  streak(sighting) "days of watching" big

  list sighting by day, "No sightings yet. Log the first bird in your garden."
row gap 2
  statcard count(sighting week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(sighting prev week), "entries last week"

table pill dose pick Morning|Evening|Extra = Morning
table bp sys num 60..260 "Top number", dia num 30..160 "Bottom number"
table sugar level num 20..600 unit "mg/dL", moment pick Fasting|After_meal|Bedtime = Fasting
screen home "Today" check
  statcard if(count(pill today) > 0, 1, 0) + if(count(bp today) > 0, 1, 0) + if(count(sugar today) > 0, 1, 0), "of 3 checks done today", 3
  row card gap 2
    stack grow gap 0
      "Pills" bold
      count(pill today) "taken today" faint
    button "Took pills" tap add pill dose = Morning
  row card gap 2
    stack grow gap 0
      "Pressure" bold
      if(count(bp today) > 0, join(last(bp.sys), "/", last(bp.dia)), "Not measured today") faint
  row card gap 2
    stack grow gap 0
      "Sugar" bold
      if(count(sugar today) > 0, join(last(sugar.level), " mg/dL"), "Not measured today") faint
screen pressure "Pressure" heart
  topbar bp, "Log reading"
  trend bp last 30 days sort at, it.sys
  list bp top 10, "No readings yet."
screen sugartab "Sugar" drop
  topbar sugar, "Log sugar"
  trend sugar last 30 days sort at, it.level
  list sugar top 10, "No sugar checks yet."

app "Mandi Rates" chart yellow
table price crop pick Wheat|Rice|Cotton|Maize|Sugarcane = Wheat, rate money, town text?
setting mine money = 4000 "My selling price"
state c pick Wheat|Rice|Cotton|Maize|Sugarcane = Wheat
topbar price, "Add rate"
choice c
statcard last(price.rate where crop = c), "latest rate for" c "against my" mine, mine
if last(price.rate where crop = c) >= mine
  "The market is at or above your price. Time to sell." color good bold
else
  "Below your selling price. Wait a little." color warn bold
row gap 2
  stat max(price.rate where crop = c), "highest"
  stat round(avg(price.rate where crop = c)), "average"

  each options price.crop as k
    row gap 2
      k bold grow
      last(price.rate where crop = k) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 70
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(last(price.rate where crop = k) / max(mine * 1.5, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "History", c
  each price where crop = c top 5 as p empty "No rates logged for this crop. Add the first one."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      stack grow gap 0
        p.rate bold
        p.town faint
      p.at faint

  each options price.crop as k
    row gap 2
      k bold grow
      if(last(price.rate where crop = k) >= mine, "Sell", "Wait") color if(last(price.rate where crop = k) >= mine, good, warn)

program_before:
app "Kiryana Store" cart slate
table item name text, unit pick Kg|Packet|Dozen|Litre = Packet, cost money, price money, qty num 0.. = 20, low num 0.. = 5
table sale item ref item, qty num 1..100 = 1
setting target money = 3000 "Daily profit goal"
let profit_on(d date) = sum(sale on d, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost))
let profit = sum(sale today, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost))
topbar item, "Add item"
statcard profit, "profit today of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat sum(sale today, it.qty * it.item.price), "sales today"
  stat count(item, it.qty <= it.low), "running low"
section "Shelf", "tap Sell for one unit"
  each item sort name as i empty "The shelf is empty. Add your first item with Add item."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      stack grow gap 0
        i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
        i.price "per" i.unit "- margin" i.price - i.cost faint
      i.qty bold
      button "Sell" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1 then add sale item = i
section "Profit per day", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, profit_on(it), target
section "Best earners", "profit this month"
  bars sale month by item.name, sum(it, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost)), it.key
section "Stock by unit"
  each options item.unit as u
    row gap 2
      u bold grow
      sum(item.qty where unit = u) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(item.qty where unit = u) / max(sum(item.qty), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Reorder today", "at or below the low level"
  each item where qty <= low sort qty as i empty "Nothing to reorder today."
    row gap 2
      i.name bold grow
      i.qty "left of" i.low faint color warn
section "This month"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(sale month, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost)), "profit"
    stat sum(sale.qty month), "units sold"
if profit >= target
  "Daily profit goal reached." color good bold

section "Hours by person", "planned"

setting target money = 500000 "MRR target"
let live = sum(sub.mrr where status = Active)
screen overview "Overview" chart
  statcard live, "MRR of" target, target
  row gap 2
    stat count(sub where status = Active), "paying customers"
    stat count(sub where status = Trial), "on trial"
    stat count(sub where status = Churned), "churned"
  section "MRR by plan", "active customers"
    share sub where status = Active by plan, sum(it.mrr), it.key
  section "New customers", "last 14 days"
    daybars last 14 days, count(sub on it)
  section "Churn", "share of all customers"
    goal count(sub where status = Churned), max(count(sub), 1), "customers lost", "lost"
  section "Average revenue", "per paying customer"
    stat round(avg(sub.mrr where status = Active)), "ARPU"
screen customers "Customers" users
  topbar sub, "Add customer"
  each sub sort at desc as s empty "No customers yet. Add your first trial."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.customer bold
        s.plan s.mrr faint
      if s.status = Trial
        button "Convert" tap set s.status = Active
      if s.status = Active
        button "Cancel" tap set s.status = Churned
screen team "Targets" target
  goal live, target, "of the MRR target"
  section "Gap", "to the target"
    row gap 2
      stat max(target - live, 0), "MRR still to find"
      stat round(max(target - live, 0) / max(avg(sub.mrr where status = Active), 1)), "customers needed"
  section "Plans"
    each options sub.plan as p
      row gap 2
        p bold grow
        count(sub where plan = p and status = Active) "active" faint

table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h

app "Cloud Costs" cloud teal
table bill service pick Compute|Storage|Database|Network|Monitoring = Compute, amount money, note text?
setting budget money = 1200 "Monthly cloud budget"

topbar bill, "Add bill"
monthnav m
statcard spent, "spent in" monthname(m) "of" budget, budget
if spent > budget
  "Over budget by" spent - budget color bad bold
section "By service", monthname(m)
  share bill month of m by service, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Spend per day", monthname(m)
  daybars month of m, sum(bill.amount on it)
section "Last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(bill.amount month of it), monthname(it)
section "Month on month", "this month and last"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(bill.amount month), "this month"
    stat sum(bill.amount month) - sum(bill.amount prev month), "change"
section "Biggest lines", "top 3"
  each bill month of m sort amount desc top 3 as b empty "No bills in this month."
    row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
      stack grow gap 0
        b.service bold
        b.note faint
      b.amount bold
list bill month of m by day, "No bills logged for this month."
section "Share of budget", "this month"
  each options bill.service as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(bill.amount month of m where service = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(bill.amount month of m where service = v) / max(budget, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Daily average", monthname(m)
  stat round(spent / max(monthdays(m), 1)), "spent per day"

  each bill top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."

program_before:
app "Volunteering" users orange
table shift hours num 0.5..24 unit "h", cause pick Food_bank|School|Mosque|Hospital|Clean_up|Other = Food_bank, place text?
setting yearly_goal num = 100 "Hours per year"
let hrs = sum(shift.hours year)
topbar shift, "Log shift"
statcard round(hrs * 10) / 10, "hours this year, goal" yearly_goal, yearly_goal
row gap 2
  statcard count(shift year), "shifts this year"
  statcard round(avg(shift.hours) * 10) / 10, "hours per shift"
section "By cause", "this year"
  share shift year by cause, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Hours per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, round(sum(shift.hours month of addmonths(today, it - 6))), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Where you help"
  share shift where place != "" by place, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Shift days", "last 10 weeks"
  heat last 70 days, count(shift on it), 1
section "On pace", "for the year"
  round(hrs / max(month(today), 1) * 12) big
  "hours by December at this pace" faint
section "Longest shift"
  max(shift.hours) "h" big
  "Last shift" since(shift) "days ago" faint
section "All shifts"
  list shift by day, "No shifts yet. Log the hours you gave this week."
row gap 2
  statcard count(shift week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(shift prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(shift) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(shift year) faint
  "Last one" since(shift) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(shift where dayname(at) = it), it
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(shift.hours) * 10) / 10 "h" big
  "Highest" max(shift.hours) "h" faint
  "Lowest" min(shift.hours) "h" faint

program_before:
app "Bug Board" tool purple dark
table bug title text, severity pick Low|Medium|High|Critical = Medium, status pick Open|Fixing|Done = Open, hours num 1..40 = 2 unit "h"
setting budget num = 60 "Sprint hours budget"
state tab pick Open|Fixing|Done = Open
let critical = count(bug where severity = Critical and status != Done)
topbar bug, "Report bug"
statcard critical, "critical bugs still open", count(bug where severity = Critical)
goal sum(bug.hours where status = Done), budget, "hours fixed this sprint", "h"
row gap 1
  each options bug.status as s
    button s count(bug where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each bug where status = tab sort hours desc as b empty "No bugs in this column. Nice and quiet."
  row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow gap 0
      b.title bold
      b.severity "-" b.hours "h" faint color if(b.severity = Critical, bad, muted)
    if b.status = Open
      button "Start" tap set b.status = Fixing
    if b.status = Fixing
      button "Done" tap set b.status = Done
section "By severity", "all bugs"
  share bug by severity, count(it), it.key
section "Hours by status", "all bugs"
  share bug by status, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Hours still to fix", "open and fixing"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(bug.hours where status = Open), "h open"
    stat sum(bug.hours where status = Fixing), "h in progress"
    stat budget - sum(bug.hours where status = Done), "h of budget left"
if sum(bug.hours where status != Done) > budget
  "Open work is more than the sprint budget. Cut scope." color warn bold
section "Done", count(bug where status = Done)
  list bug where status = Done top 5, "Nothing fixed yet. Pick a bug and press Start."
section "Hours per severity", "all bugs"
  each options bug.severity as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(bug.hours where severity = v) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(bug.hours where severity = v) / max(sum(bug.hours), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Longest open bug"
  each bug where status != Done sort hours desc top 1 as b empty "No open bugs."
    row card gap 2
      b.title bold grow
      b.hours "h" bold

program_before:
app "Home repairs" tool slate
table job title text, room pick Kitchen|Bathroom|Bedroom|Roof|Garden|Other = Kitchen, status pick Todo|Doing|Done = Todo, cost money?, due date?
setting budget money = 50000 "Repair budget for the year"
state tab pick Todo|Doing|Done = Todo
let spent = sum(job.cost year where status = Done)
topbar job, "Add job"
row gap 2
  statcard count(job where status != Done), "open jobs"
  statcard spent, "spent this year, budget" budget, budget
row gap 1
  each options job.status as s
    button s count(job where status = s) fill if(tab = s, ink, surface) grow tap set tab = s
each job where status = tab sort due as j empty "No jobs here. Add the leaking tap, the cracked tile, the loose door."
  row card gap 2 tap edit j swipe remove j
    stack grow gap 0
      j.title bold
      j.room j.due faint
    j.cost faint
    if j.status = Todo
      button "Start" tap set j.status = Doing
    if j.status = Doing
      button "Done" fill accent tap set j.status = Done
section "Spend by room", "all done jobs"
  share job where status = Done by room, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Spend per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(job.cost month of addmonths(today, it - 6) where status = Done), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Overdue jobs"
  each job where status != Done and due < today sort due as j empty "Nothing overdue."
    row gap 2
      j.title grow
      "Late" today - j.due "days" color bad
section "Biggest job"
  max(job.cost) big
  "Jobs finished this year" count(job year where status = Done) faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(job week), "entries this week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(job) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(job year) faint

  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(job where dayname(at) = it), it

program_before:
app "Sunnah" star mint
table deed name text, when_ pick Morning|Day|Evening|Night = Morning
table did deed ref deed
let n = count(deed)
let finished = count(did today)
topbar deed, "Add a deed"
statcard finished, "of" n "deeds done today", n
if finished = n and n > 0
  "All deeds done today. May Allah accept." head
each deed sort when_ as d empty "No deeds yet. Add morning adhkar, duha prayer, reading a page of Quran."
  stack card gap 2 tap edit d swipe remove d
    row gap 2
      stack grow gap 0
        d.name bold
        d.when_ faint
        streak(d.did) "day streak, best" best(d.did) faint
      toggle d.did
    weekdots count(d.did on it) > 0
section "Last 6 weeks", "average" round(count(did last 42 days) * 100 / max(n * 42, 1)) "%"
  daygrid last 42 days, count(did on it), max(n, 1)
section "Deeds done per day", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, count(did on it), max(n, 1)
section "By time of day", "this month"
  each options deed.when_ as w
    row gap 1
      w grow
      count(did month where deed.when_ = w) bold
section "Most consistent", "this month"
  each deed sort count(it.did month) desc top 3 as d empty "Add deeds to see this."
    row gap 2
      d.name grow
      count(d.did month) "days" bold
section "Needs love", "least done this month"
  each deed sort count(it.did month) top 2 as d empty "Add deeds to see this."
    row gap 2
      d.name grow
      count(d.did month) "days" faint

  statcard count(did prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"

program_before:
app "CI Runs" tool slate
table run branch text, passed num 0..5000 = 300, failed num 0..5000 = 0, mins num 1..90 = 8 unit "min"
setting limit num = 10 "Slow run limit (min)"
let total = sum(run.passed) + sum(run.failed)
let rate = round(sum(run.passed) * 1000 / max(total, 1)) / 10
topbar run, "Log run"
statcard rate, "percent of tests passing", 100
row gap 2
  stat count(run today), "runs today"
  stat count(run week where failed > 0), "red runs this week"
  stat round(avg(run.mins week) * 10) / 10, "average minutes"
if count(run today where mins > limit) > 0
  "Slow runs today:" count(run today where mins > limit) "over" limit "minutes" color warn bold
section "Run time", "last 14 days"
  trend run last 14 days sort at, it.mins
section "Failed tests per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(run.failed on it)
section "Failing runs", "newest first"
  each run where failed > 0 top 5 as r empty "No failing runs. Green across the board."
    row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.branch bold
        r.failed "failed of" r.passed + r.failed faint
      r.mins "min" color if(r.mins > limit, warn, ink)
section "Slowest runs", "top 3"
  each run sort mins desc top 3 as r
    row gap 2
      r.branch bold grow
      r.mins "min" faint
section "Pass rate", "last 7 days"
  each days last 7 days as d
    row gap 2
      dayname(d) grow
      count(run on d) "runs" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(run.passed on d) / max(sum(run.passed on d) + sum(run.failed on d), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill good radius 2

  each run top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."

table hire farmer text, work pick Ploughing|Seeding|Harvesting|Hauling = Ploughing, hours num 1..24 = 4 unit "h", rate money = 1800, paid bool
setting target num = 80 "Hours a week I want to run"
let owed = sum(hire where paid = no, it.hours * it.rate)
topbar hire, "Log hire"
statcard owed, "still owed by" count(hire where paid = no) "farmers"
goal sum(hire.hours week), target, "hours run this week", "h"
section "Unpaid", "tick when the farmer pays"
  each hire where paid = no sort at as h empty "Nobody owes you. All hires are paid."
    row card gap 2 tap edit h swipe remove h
      toggle h.paid
      stack grow gap 0
        h.farmer bold
        h.work "-" h.hours "h at" h.rate faint
      h.hours * h.rate bold
section "Hours by work", "this month"
  share hire month by work, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Earnings per week", "last 6 weeks"
  bars days last 6 weeks, sum(hire week of it, it.hours * it.rate), monthday(it)
section "Busiest days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, sum(hire.hours on it), 8
section "Best farmers", "hours this year"
  bars hire year by farmer, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "This month"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(hire month, it.hours * it.rate), "earned"
    stat sum(hire.hours month), "hours"
    stat count(hire month), "hires"
section "Hours per work type", "this month"
  each options hire.work as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(hire.hours month where work = v) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(hire.hours month where work = v) / max(sum(hire.hours month), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each hire top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.farmer bold
        x.work faint
      x.hours "h" bold

request: I want to look at a section called "Handling time" and the small note "last 14 days" that contains a trend line of mins in ticket over the last 14 days above the "Tickets per priority" card, just that.
program_before:
app "Helpdesk" phone mint
table ticket subject text, channel pick Email|Chat|Phone|Social = Email, priority pick Low|Normal|Urgent = Normal, status pick New|Working|Solved = New, mins num 1..600 = 15 unit "min"
setting sla num = 30 "Handling target (min)"
state tab pick New|Working|Solved = New
topbar ticket, "Log ticket"
row gap 2
  stat count(ticket where status != Solved), "open"
  stat count(ticket where priority = Urgent and status != Solved), "urgent"
  stat count(ticket today where status = Solved), "solved today"
statcard round(avg(ticket.mins week)), "average minutes, target" sla, sla
row gap 1
  each options ticket.status as s
    button s count(ticket where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each ticket where status = tab sort priority desc as t empty "Nothing in this list."
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    stack grow gap 0
      t.subject bold
      t.channel "-" t.mins "min" faint color if(t.mins > sla, warn, muted)
    if t.priority = Urgent
      "Urgent" color bad bold
    if t.status = New
      button "Take" tap set t.status = Working
    if t.status = Working
      button "Solve" tap set t.status = Solved
section "By channel", "this week"
  share ticket week by channel, count(it), it.key
section "Tickets per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(ticket on it)
section "Tickets per priority", "still open"
  each options ticket.priority as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(ticket where priority = v and status != Solved) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(ticket where priority = v and status != Solved) / max(count(ticket where status != Solved), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if count(ticket where status != Solved) > 20
  "The queue is long. Ask for help." color warn bold

app "Garden" tree green dark
table harvest crop pick Tomato|Chilli|Okra|Spinach|Mint|Other = Tomato, kg num 0.1..100 unit "kg"

    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s

      s.rows "rows" s.day faint
  form sow, "Add sowing"
section "Days since last harvest"
  since(harvest) big
  "Streak" streak(harvest) "days" faint
section "Harvests"
  list harvest by day, "No harvest yet. Tap Log harvest when you pick the first tomato."
row gap 2
  statcard count(harvest week), "entries this week"

user_text:
Edit request: i want to look at a section called "Topics" and the small note "this month" that contains a comparison chart: session grouped by topic, the total mins this month right before the "Problems solved per week" card, thanks

Current program:
app "Code practice" tool ink dark
table session mins num 5..480 unit "min", topic pick Python|Web|Algorithms|Databases|Git|Other = Python, solved num 0..50 = 1, note text?
setting weekly_goal num = 300 "Minutes per week"
let wk = sum(session.mins week)
topbar session, "Log session"
statcard wk, "min this week, goal" weekly_goal, weekly_goal
row gap 2
  statcard sum(session.solved month), "problems solved this month"
  statcard streak(session), "day streak"
  statcard count(session month), "sessions this month"
section "Minutes per day", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, sum(session.mins on it), weekly_goal / 7
section "Problems solved per week", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, sum(session.solved week of (today - 7 * (8 - it))), join("W", it)
section "Coding days", "last 10 weeks"
  heat last 70 days, count(session on it), 2
section "Per topic", "hours"
  each options session.topic as t
    row gap 1
      t grow
      round(sum(session.mins where topic = t) / 60 * 10) / 10 "h" bold
section "What you learned"
  each session where note != "" top 4 as s empty "Add a note each time. One line is enough."
    row gap 2
      s.note grow
      s.topic faint
section "Sessions"
  list session by day, "No sessions yet. Start with 25 minutes."
row gap 2
  statcard count(session week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(session prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(session) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(session year) faint
  "Last one" since(session) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(session where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(session on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(session.mins) * 10) / 10 "min" big
  "Highest" max(session.mins) "min" faint
  "Lowest" min(session.mins) "min" faint

app "Makeup fasts" moon ink dark
table fast kind pick Ramadan_qaza|Monday|Thursday|White_days|Vow = Ramadan_qaza, note text?

let qaza = count(fast where kind = Ramadan_qaza)
let left = max(owed - qaza, 0)
let voluntary = count(fast year where kind != Ramadan_qaza)
remind "Tomorrow is a Monday. Intend the fast tonight." at 20:00 on sun
topbar fast, "Log a fast"
statcard left, "Ramadan fasts still owed of" owed, owed
if left = 0
  "All Ramadan fasts are made up. Alhamdulillah." head

  bars 1..6, count(fast month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Streaks"
  row gap 2
    stat streak(fast), "days in a row"
    stat best(fast), "best run"
    stat since(fast), "days since last fast"
section "Latest fasts"
  list fast top 10, "No fasts logged yet. Tap Log a fast on the day you fast."
section "Days since each kind"
  each options fast.kind as k
    row gap 1
      k grow
      if(count(fast where kind = k) > 0, join(since(fast where kind = k), " days"), "never") faint
section "This year", "plan:" yearly_goal "voluntary fasts"
  goal voluntary, yearly_goal, "voluntary fasts done", ""
section "Notes"
  each fast where note != "" top 4 as f empty "No notes yet. Write your intention when you log a fast."

program_before:
app "Driver Book" car ink
table trip fare money, km num 1..500 = 5 unit "km", kind pick Ride|Parcel|Airport = Ride
table fuel cost money
setting target money = 5000 "Daily earnings target"
setting mileage num = 14 "Car km per litre"
let earned = sum(trip.fare today)
screen trips "Trips" car
  topbar trip, "Add trip"
  statcard earned, "earned today of" target, target
  row gap 2
    stat count(trip today), "trips"
    stat sum(trip.km today), "km driven"
    stat round(earned / max(sum(trip.km today), 1)), "per km"
  section "Last 7 days", "goal met on" count(days last 7 days, sum(trip.fare on it) >= target) "days"
    goalbars last 7 days, sum(trip.fare on it), target
  list trip today by day, "No trips yet today. Tap Add trip after the first fare."
screen fuelscr "Fuel" bolt
  topbar fuel, "Add fuel"
  statcard sum(fuel.cost month), "fuel spent this month"
  stat round(sum(trip.km month) / mileage), "litres the trips needed"
  section "Where the money goes", "this month"
    share trip month by kind, sum(it.fare), it.key
  section "Fuel stops"
    list fuel top 8, "No fuel bought yet. Add your next fill-up."
screen summary "Summary" chart
  section "This week", "earnings"
    daybars week, sum(trip.fare on it)
  row gap 2
    stat sum(trip.fare week), "earned"
    stat sum(fuel.cost week), "fuel"
    stat sum(trip.fare week) - sum(fuel.cost week), "kept"
  section "Trips by kind"
    share trip week by kind, count(it), it.key
screen log "Quick add" plus
  form trip, "Save trip"
  form fuel, "Save fuel"

app "Car care" tool slate dark
table job kind pick Oil|Tyres|Brakes|Battery|Filter|Other = Oil, at_km num 0..999999 unit "km", cost money
setting odo num = 85000 "Odometer now (km)"
setting oil_every num = 5000 "Oil change every (km)"
let oil_due = last(job.at_km where kind = Oil) + oil_every
topbar job, "Log job"
row gap 2
  statcard odo, "km on the clock"
  statcard max(oil_due - odo, 0), "km until the next oil change"
section "Oil change", "progress to the next one"
  goal clamp(odo - last(job.at_km where kind = Oil), 0, oil_every), oil_every, "km since the last oil change", "km"
section "Last done", "by job"
  each options job.kind as k
    row gap 1
      k grow
      if(count(job where kind = k) > 0, join(odo - last(job.at_km where kind = k), " km ago"), "never") faint
section "Spend by job", "all time"
  share job by kind, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Spend per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(job.cost month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Total spent"
  sum(job.cost year) big
  "this year, over" count(job year) "jobs" faint
section "Service history"
  list job by day, "No jobs logged yet. Add your last oil change to start."
row gap 2
  statcard count(job week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(job prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(job) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(job year) faint
  "Last one" since(job) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(job where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(job on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(job.at_km) * 10) / 10 "km" big
  "Highest" max(job.at_km) "km" faint
  "Lowest" min(job.at_km) "km" faint

table growth cm num 30..200 unit "cm", kg num 2..120 unit "kg", note text?

    row gap 2
      r.phone bold grow
      r.issue faint

    stat count(repair where status = Ready), "ready to collect"

  daybars last 14 days, count(repair on it)

        g.cause bold
        g.note faint

request: Create a section called "Portions per shift" and the small note "last 14 days" that contains bars of the total portions from shift per day for the last 14 days with a goal line at the target right before the "Latest shifts" card, thanks a lot
program_before:
app "Food Truck" food orange
table shift place pick Campus|Office_park|Market|Stadium|Beach = Campus, sales money, costs money, portions num 1..500 = 80
setting target num = 100 "Portions per shift goal"
let profit = sum(shift, it.sales - it.costs)
topbar shift, "Log shift"
statcard sum(shift.sales week) - sum(shift.costs week), "profit this week"
row gap 2
  stat count(shift week), "shifts"
  stat round(avg(shift.portions week)), "average portions"
  stat round(sum(shift week, it.sales - it.costs) * 100 / max(sum(shift.sales week), 1)), "percent margin"
section "Best place", "profit per place, all time"
  share shift by place, sum(it, it.sales - it.costs), it.key
section "Sales", "last 10 shifts"
  trend shift last 30 days sort at, it.sales
section "Latest shifts"
  each shift top 4 as s empty "No shifts logged yet. Log tonight's shift."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.place bold
        s.portions "portions" faint
      stack gap 0 align end
        s.sales - s.costs bold color if(s.sales >= s.costs, good, bad)
        "profit" tiny faint
section "All time", "profit"
  stat profit, "total profit"
section "Portions per place", "all time"
  each options shift.place as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(shift.portions where place = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(shift.portions where place = v) / max(sum(shift.portions), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Newest first", "tap one to edit it"
  each shift top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.place bold
        x.portions "portions" faint
      x.sales bold

user_text:
Edit request: Create a section called "Portions per shift" and the small note "last 14 days" that contains bars of the total portions from shift per day for the last 14 days with a goal line at the target right before the "Latest shifts" card, thanks a lot

Current program:
app "Food Truck" food orange
table shift place pick Campus|Office_park|Market|Stadium|Beach = Campus, sales money, costs money, portions num 1..500 = 80
setting target num = 100 "Portions per shift goal"
let profit = sum(shift, it.sales - it.costs)
topbar shift, "Log shift"
statcard sum(shift.sales week) - sum(shift.costs week), "profit this week"
row gap 2
  stat count(shift week), "shifts"
  stat round(avg(shift.portions week)), "average portions"
  stat round(sum(shift week, it.sales - it.costs) * 100 / max(sum(shift.sales week), 1)), "percent margin"
section "Best place", "profit per place, all time"
  share shift by place, sum(it, it.sales - it.costs), it.key
section "Sales", "last 10 shifts"
  trend shift last 30 days sort at, it.sales
section "Latest shifts"
  each shift top 4 as s empty "No shifts logged yet. Log tonight's shift."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.place bold
        s.portions "portions" faint
      stack gap 0 align end
        s.sales - s.costs bold color if(s.sales >= s.costs, good, bad)
        "profit" tiny faint
section "All time", "profit"
  stat profit, "total profit"
section "Portions per place", "all time"
  each options shift.place as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(shift.portions where place = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(shift.portions where place = v) / max(sum(shift.portions), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Newest first", "tap one to edit it"
  each shift top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.place bold
        x.portions "portions" faint
      x.sales bold

request: Show me a log of all the points.
program_before:
app "Ludo" dice ocean
table point team pick Red|Blue, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Red)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Blue)
setting winat num = 50 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Red" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Red, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Red, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Blue" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Blue, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Blue, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Red win!" head color good

        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(task.points where owner = v) / max(commit / 4, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

app "Chess" board slate dark
table game opponent text, side pick White|Black = White, result pick Win|Draw|Loss = Win, moves num 5..200 = 35

  button "All" fill if(show = All, accent, soft) tap set show = All
  each options game.result as r
    button r fill if(show = r, accent, soft) tap set show = r

  row card gap 2 tap edit g swipe remove g
    stack grow gap 0
      "vs" g.opponent bold
      g.side g.moves "moves" faint
    g.result bold color if(g.result = Win, good, if(g.result = Loss, bad, ink))
row gap 2
  statcard count(game week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(game prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(game) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(game year) faint
  "Last one" since(game) "days ago" faint

  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(game where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Packing" bag teal
table pack name text, bag pick Suitcase|Backpack|Carry_on|Kids_bag = Suitcase, grams num 0..30000 = 200 unit "g", must bool
table packed pack ref pack
state filter pick All|Suitcase|Backpack|Carry_on|Kids_bag = All
let n = count(pack)
let got = count(pack, count(it.packed all) > 0)
topbar pack, "Add item"
statcard got, "of" n "items packed", n
if got = n and n > 0
  "Everything is packed. Have a safe trip." head
row gap 1
  button "All" fill if(filter = All, accent, soft) tap set filter = All
  each options pack.bag as b
    button b count(pack where bag = b) fill if(filter = b, accent, soft) tap set filter = b

  row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p

      p.name bold
      p.bag p.grams "g" faint
    if p.must
      "Must" color warn small
    toggle p.packed all
section "Still to pack", "must-have items first"
  each pack sort name as p empty "No items yet."
    if count(p.packed all) = 0
      row gap 2
        p.name grow
        p.bag faint
section "Heaviest items"
  each pack sort grams desc top 3 as p empty "No items yet."
    row gap 2
      p.name grow
      p.grams "g" bold

  round(sum(pack.grams) / 100) / 10 "kg in all" big

  statcard count(packed week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(packed prev week), "entries last week"

app "Review Queue" list blue

  each options pr.author as v
    row gap 2

        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(pr where author = v and status = Waiting) / max(waiting, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

request: when you have a minute, would you add a section called "Jobs by garment" and the small note "all time" that contains a breakdown of job by kind showing how many there are right before the "Income per week" section?
program_before:
app "Tailor Shop" pen plum
table job customer text, kind pick Shalwar_kameez|Waistcoat|Blouse|Suit|Alteration = Shalwar_kameez, due date, price money, advance money = 0, done bool
setting rush num = 3 "Rush job if due within (days)"
let balance = sum(job, it.price - it.advance)
topbar job, "New job"
statcard balance, "still to collect on" count(job where done = no) "open jobs"
row gap 2
  stat count(job where done = no and due <= today + rush), "rush jobs"
  stat sum(job.advance month), "advances this month"
  stat count(job where done = yes), "finished"
section "Open jobs", "by due date"
  each job where done = no sort due as j empty "No open jobs. Add the next stitching order."
    row card gap 2 tap edit j swipe remove j
      toggle j.done
      stack grow gap 0
        j.customer bold
        j.kind "- due" j.due faint color if(j.due <= today + rush, warn, muted)
      stack gap 0 align end
        j.price - j.advance bold
        "to pay" tiny faint
section "Income per week", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, sum(job.price week of it where done = yes), monthday(it)
section "Finished"
  list job where done = yes top 5, "No finished jobs yet."
section "Money owed", "balance per customer"
  each job where done = no sort price desc top 4 as j
    row gap 2
      j.customer bold grow
      j.price - j.advance bold
section "Advance taken", "this month"
  goal sum(job.advance month), max(sum(job.price month), 1), "of the month's job value"
section "Jobs started", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(job on it)
if count(job where done = no and due < today) > 0
  "Some jobs are past their due date." color bad bold
section "Open jobs per garment", "not finished"
  each options job.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(job where kind = v and done = no) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(job where kind = v and done = no) / max(count(job where done = no), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

table order customer text, kg num 1..50 = 5 unit "kg", service pick Wash_fold|Dry_clean|Iron_only = Wash_fold, price money, status pick Received|Washing|Ready|Collected = Received
setting capacity num = 120 "Kilos I can wash a day"
state tab pick Received|Washing|Ready|Collected = Received
topbar order, "New order"
goal sum(order.kg today), capacity, "kilos received today", "kg"
row gap 2
  stat sum(order.price where status = Ready), "waiting to be paid"
  stat count(order where status = Ready), "ready to collect"
  stat sum(order.price today), "billed today"
row gap 1
  each options order.status as s
    button s count(order where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each order where status = tab sort at as o empty "No orders in this stage."
  row card gap 2 tap edit o swipe remove o
    stack grow gap 0
      o.customer bold
      o.kg "kg -" o.service faint
    o.price bold
    if o.status = Received
      button "Wash" tap set o.status = Washing
    if o.status = Washing
      button "Ready" tap set o.status = Ready
    if o.status = Ready
      button "Handed over" tap set o.status = Collected
section "Orders per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(order on it)
section "Services", "this month"
  share order month by service, sum(it.price), it.key
section "Kilos per day", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(order.kg on it), capacity
section "Waiting to be collected"
  each order where status = Ready sort at as o empty "Nothing waiting at the counter."
    row gap 2
      o.customer bold grow
      o.price faint
section "Weekly kilos"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(order.kg week), "kg this week"
    stat sum(order.price week), "billed this week"
    stat count(order week), "orders"

request: One small change: would you add a section called "Which service fails" and the small note "minutes down, all time" that contains a breakdown of incident by service showing the total down right before the "Severity mix" card?
program_before:
app "Uptime" bolt ink
table incident service pick Auth|Payments|Search|Gateway|Email = Gateway, severity pick Minor|Major|Outage = Minor, down num 1..600 = 10 unit "min", resolved bool
setting slo num = 99.9 "Uptime target (percent)"
let lost = sum(incident.down month)
let minutes = monthdays(today) * 1440
let uptime = round((1 - lost / minutes) * 10000) / 100
topbar incident, "Log incident"
statcard uptime, "percent uptime, target" slo, 100
row gap 2
  stat lost, "minutes down this month"
  stat count(incident month where severity = Outage), "full outages"
  stat count(incident where resolved = no), "still open"
if uptime < slo
  "Below the target. Error budget is spent." color bad bold
section "Open incidents", "tick when resolved"
  each incident where resolved = no sort at as i empty "Nothing open. All services are healthy."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      toggle i.resolved
      stack grow gap 0
        i.service i.severity bold color if(i.severity = Outage, bad, ink)
        i.down "min down" faint
section "Downtime per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(incident.down on it)
section "Severity mix", "this month"
  bars incident month by severity, count(it), it.key
section "History"
  list incident where resolved = yes top 5, "No resolved incidents yet."
section "Minutes down per service", "this month"
  each options incident.service as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(incident.down month where service = v) "min" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(incident.down month where service = v) / max(lost, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Last incident"
  each incident top 1 as i empty "No incidents logged. Quiet month."
    row card gap 2
      i.service bold grow
      i.severity faint

app "Fridge" box teal
table food name text, kind pick Cooked|Dairy|Veg|Meat|Other = Cooked, made date = today, lasts num 1..30 = 3 unit "days"

          if today - f.made > f.lasts
            "Past its day by" today - f.made - f.lasts "days" color bad small

            f.lasts - (today - f.made) "days left" faint
        toggle f.eaten all

app "Migraines" brain plum
table attack pain num 1..10 = 5, hours num 1..72 = 3 unit "h", trigger pick Stress|Lack_of_sleep|Screen|Food|Weather|Unknown = Unknown, relief text?

statcard n, "attacks this month, worry level" worry, worry
if n >= worry
  "This is above your worry level. Consider talking to your doctor." color warn bold
row gap 2
  stat since(attack), "days since last attack"
  stat round(avg(attack.pain last 3 months) * 10) / 10, "average pain, 3 months"
  stat sum(attack.hours month), "hours of pain this month"
section "Pain over time", "last 3 months"
  trend attack last 90 days, it.pain
section "Attack days", "last 10 weeks"
  heat last 70 days, count(attack on it), 2
section "Per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, count(attack month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))

    row gap 2

  list attack by day, "No attacks logged. That is good news."

  row gap 2
    stat count(attack where pain >= 7), "severe (7 or more)"
    stat count(attack where pain >= 4 and pain < 7), "moderate"

section "Longest attack", "all time"
  max(attack.hours) "h" big
  "Average length" round(avg(attack.hours)) "h" faint
section "Tips"
  "Write the trigger every time. After a month the pattern shows." faint

  statcard count(attack week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(attack prev week), "entries last week"

app "Eid shopping" bag green
table buy item text, for_who text, shop text?, price money, kind pick Clothes|Shoes|Food|Gifts|Decor = Clothes

setting budget money = 40000 "Eid budget"
let spent = sum(buy, it.price * count(it.got all))
let planned = sum(buy.price)
topbar buy, "Add item"
row gap 2
  statcard round(spent), "spent so far, budget" budget, budget

let n = count(member)
let paid_now = count(member, count(it.pay month) > 0)
let pot = n * dues
topbar member, "Add member"
row gap 2
  statcard paid_now, "of" n "paid this month", n
  statcard pot, "pot this month"
section "Members", "tap the tick when paid"
  each member sort turn as m empty "No members yet. Add each person and their turn number."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      stack grow gap 0
        m.name bold
        "Turn" m.turn faint
      toggle m.pay month
section "Whose turn", monthname(today)
  each member sort turn top 1 as m empty "Add members first."
    row gap 2
      m.name head grow
      pot bold
section "Still to pay", "this month"
  each member sort name as m empty "No members yet."
    if count(m.pay month) = 0
      row gap 2
        m.name grow
        dues faint
section "Collected per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(pay.amount month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Rounds left"
  max(n - month(today), 0) big
  "months until everyone has had a turn, if you started in January" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(pay week), "entries this week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(pay) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(pay year) faint
  "Last one" since(pay) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(pay where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Fleet Care" car slate
table vehicle plate text, kind pick Truck|Van|Pickup|Bike = Truck
table service vehicle ref vehicle, work pick Oil|Tyres|Brakes|Engine|Inspection = Oil, cost money
setting interval num = 90 "Service every (days)"
let due = count(vehicle, due(it.service, interval))
topbar vehicle, "Add vehicle"
row gap 2
  stat count(vehicle), "vehicles"
  stat due, "due for service"
  stat sum(service.cost month), "spent this month"
section "Vehicles", "oldest service first"
  each vehicle sort since(it.service) desc as v empty "No vehicles yet. Add your first truck or van."
    row card gap 2 tap edit v swipe remove v
      stack grow gap 0
        v.plate bold
        v.kind "- last service" since(v.service) "days ago" faint color if(due(v.service, interval), bad, muted)
      sum(v.service.cost) bold
section "Cost per vehicle", "all time"
  bars vehicle, sum(it.service.cost), it.plate
section "Spend per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(service.cost month of it), monthname(it)
section "Work done", "by type"
  share service by work, count(it), it.key
section "Log a service"
  form service, "Save service"
list service top 5, "No services logged yet."
section "Vehicles per kind", "fleet size"
  each options vehicle.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(vehicle where kind = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(vehicle where kind = v) / max(count(vehicle), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

user_text:
Edit request: Insert a big number for the total cost from service this month with the caption "spent this month" after the "due for service" box, just that

Current program:
app "Fleet Care" car slate
table vehicle plate text, kind pick Truck|Van|Pickup|Bike = Truck
table service vehicle ref vehicle, work pick Oil|Tyres|Brakes|Engine|Inspection = Oil, cost money, km num 0..900000
setting interval num = 90 "Service every (days)"
let due = count(vehicle, due(it.service, interval))
topbar vehicle, "Add vehicle"
row gap 2
  stat count(vehicle), "vehicles"
  stat due, "due for service"
section "Vehicles", "oldest service first"
  each vehicle sort since(it.service) desc as v empty "No vehicles yet. Add your first truck or van."
    row card gap 2 tap edit v swipe remove v
      stack grow gap 0
        v.plate bold
        v.kind "- last service" since(v.service) "days ago" faint color if(due(v.service, interval), bad, muted)
      sum(v.service.cost) bold
section "Cost per vehicle", "all time"
  bars vehicle, sum(it.service.cost), it.plate
section "Spend per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(service.cost month of it), monthname(it)
section "Work done", "by type"
  share service by work, count(it), it.key
section "Log a service"
  form service, "Save service"
list service top 5, "No services logged yet."
section "Vehicles per kind", "fleet size"
  each options vehicle.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(vehicle where kind = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(vehicle where kind = v) / max(count(vehicle), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Due now"
  each vehicle where due(service, interval) as v empty "No vehicle is due. Everything is serviced."
    row gap 2
      v.plate bold grow
      "Due" color bad
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each vehicle top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.plate bold
        x.kind faint
      sum(x.service.cost) bold

request: Hello, add on a stat showing the number of student entries, captioned "students" below the salaries stat, please.

app "Tuition" school plum
table student name text, fee money
table feepaid student ref student, amount money
table exam subject text, on_date date
table teacher name text, salary money
state m date = today
monthnav m
"Profit this month" sum(feepaid.amount month of m) - sum(teacher.salary) big
row gap 2
  stat sum(feepaid.amount month of m), "fees collected"
  stat sum(teacher.salary), "salaries"
"Fees not yet paid this month" head
each student as s
  if sum(s.feepaid.amount month of m) < s.fee
    row card
      s.name grow
      s.fee - sum(s.feepaid.amount month of m) color bad
"Exams" head
each exam sort on_date as e
  row card tap edit e swipe remove e
    e.subject bold grow
    e.on_date
form student, "Add student"
form feepaid, "Add fee payment"
form exam, "Add exam"
form teacher, "Add teacher"

request: add on a section called "Busy days" and the small note "last 5 weeks" that contains a day grid for the last 35 days with how many title entries there are per day, where 2 is the fullest
program_before:
app "Watchlist" cards purple
table title name text, kind pick Movie|Series|Documentary|Anime = Movie, status pick Want|Watching|Watched = Want, stars num? 1..5, finished date?
state tab pick Want|Watching|Watched = Want
topbar title, "Add title"
row gap 2
  statcard count(title where status = Watched), "watched"
  statcard count(title where status = Want), "on the list"
row gap 1
  each options title.status as s
    button s count(title where status = s) fill if(tab = s, ink, surface) grow tap set tab = s
each title where status = tab sort name as t empty "Nothing here yet. Add a film someone told you about."
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    stack grow gap 0
      t.name bold
      t.kind t.stars faint
    if t.status = Want
      button "Start" tap set t.status = Watching
    if t.status = Watching
      button "Finished" tap set t.status = Watched then set t.finished = today
section "Watched per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, count(title where finished >= addmonths(today, it - 6) and finished < addmonths(today, it - 5)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "What you like", "watched by kind"
  share title where status = Watched by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Top rated"
  each title sort stars desc top 3 as t empty "Rate a title to see your favourites."
    row gap 2
      t.name grow
      t.stars "stars" bold
section "Average rating"
  round(avg(title.stars) * 10) / 10 big
  "out of 5 across" count(title where stars > 0) "rated titles" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(title week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(title prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(title) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(title year) faint
  "Last one" since(title) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(title where dayname(at) = it), it

program_before:
app "Ad Spend" chart yellow
table campaign name text, channel pick Facebook|Google|Instagram|Flyers|WhatsApp = Facebook, spend money, leads num 0..5000 = 0, sales num 0..5000 = 0
setting budget money = 100000 "Monthly ad budget"
let spent = sum(campaign.spend month)
topbar campaign, "Add campaign"
statcard spent, "spent this month of" budget, budget
row gap 2
  stat sum(campaign.leads month), "leads"
  stat sum(campaign.sales month), "sales"
  stat round(spent / max(sum(campaign.leads month), 1)), "cost per lead"
section "Cost per lead", "by channel, this month"
  bars campaign month by channel, round(sum(it.spend) / max(sum(it.leads), 1)), it.key
section "Spend", "by channel"
  share campaign month by channel, sum(it.spend), it.key
section "Leads to sales"
  each options campaign.channel as c
    row gap 2
      c bold grow
      sum(campaign.sales month where channel = c) "of" sum(campaign.leads month where channel = c) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(campaign.sales month where channel = c) / max(sum(campaign.leads month where channel = c), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Best campaigns", "most sales"
  each campaign sort sales desc top 3 as c empty "No campaigns yet. Add the first one."
    row card gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
      stack grow gap 0
        c.name bold
        c.channel faint
      c.sales "sales" bold
if spent > budget
  "Over the ad budget. Pause the weakest channel." color bad bold
list campaign top 5, "No campaigns yet."
section "Newest first", "tap one to edit it"
  each campaign top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        x.channel faint
      x.spend bold

program_before:
app "Invoices" money teal
table invoice client text, amount money, issued date = today, paid bool
setting goal money = 250000 "Monthly income goal"
let owed = sum(invoice.amount where paid = no)
let late = count(invoice where paid = no and issued < today - 30)
topbar invoice, "New invoice"
statcard owed, "still owed by" count(invoice where paid = no) "clients"
if late > 0
  "Chase" plural(late, "invoice") "older than 30 days" bold color bad
goal sum(invoice.amount month where paid = yes), goal, "paid this month"
section "Income per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(invoice.amount month of it where paid = yes), monthname(it)
section "Top clients", "by amount billed"
  share invoice by client, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Unpaid"
  each invoice where paid = no sort issued as i empty "Everything is paid. Enjoy it."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      toggle i.paid
      stack grow gap 0
        i.client bold
        "Issued" i.issued faint color if(i.issued < today - 30, bad, muted)
      i.amount bold
section "Paid", count(invoice where paid = yes)
  list invoice where paid = yes top 6, "Nothing paid yet."
section "Billed per week", "last 4 weeks"
  daybars last 28 days, sum(invoice.amount on it)
section "Average invoice", "all time"
  row gap 2
    stat round(avg(invoice.amount)), "average amount"
    stat max(invoice.amount), "biggest invoice"
    stat count(invoice month), "sent this month"
section "Slowest payers", "unpaid, oldest first"
  each invoice where paid = no sort issued top 3 as i empty "Nobody is late."
    row gap 2
      i.client bold grow
      plural(today - i.issued, "day") faint
      i.amount bold
section "Paid share", "of everything billed"
  goal sum(invoice.amount where paid = yes), max(sum(invoice.amount), 1), "already paid"
if owed > goal
  "More is owed than your monthly goal. Send reminders." color warn bold

table invoice client text, amount money, issued date = today, paid bool
setting goal money = 250000 "Monthly income goal"
let owed = sum(invoice.amount where paid = no)
let late = count(invoice where paid = no and issued < today - 30)
topbar invoice, "New invoice"
statcard owed, "still owed by" count(invoice where paid = no) "clients"
if late > 0
  "Chase" plural(late, "invoice") "older than 30 days" bold color bad
goal sum(invoice.amount month where paid = yes), goal, "paid this month"
section "Income per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(invoice.amount month of it where paid = yes), monthname(it)
section "Top clients", "by amount billed"
  share invoice by client, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Unpaid"
  each invoice where paid = no sort issued as i empty "Everything is paid. Enjoy it."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      toggle i.paid
      stack grow gap 0
        i.client bold
        "Issued" i.issued faint color if(i.issued < today - 30, bad, muted)
      i.amount bold
section "Paid", count(invoice where paid = yes)
  list invoice where paid = yes top 6, "Nothing paid yet."
section "Billed per week", "last 4 weeks"
  daybars last 28 days, sum(invoice.amount on it)
section "Average invoice", "all time"
  row gap 2
    stat round(avg(invoice.amount)), "average amount"
    stat max(invoice.amount), "biggest invoice"
    stat count(invoice month), "sent this month"
section "Slowest payers", "unpaid, oldest first"
  each invoice where paid = no sort issued top 3 as i empty "Nobody is late."
    row gap 2
      i.client bold grow
      plural(today - i.issued, "day") faint
      i.amount bold
section "Cash in", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(invoice.amount on it where paid = yes)
section "Paid share", "of everything billed"
  goal sum(invoice.amount where paid = yes), max(sum(invoice.amount), 1), "already paid"
if owed > goal
  "More is owed than your monthly goal. Send reminders." color warn bold

program_before:
app "Photo walks" eye ink
table walkp place text, theme pick Street|Nature|People|Buildings|Light = Street, shots num 1..500 = 20 unit "shots", keepers num 0..100 = 3
setting challenge num = 100 "Keepers this year"
let kept = sum(walkp.keepers year)
topbar walkp, "Log a walk"
statcard kept, "keepers this year of" challenge, challenge
row gap 2
  statcard count(walkp month), "walks this month"
  statcard sum(walkp.shots month), "shots this month"
  statcard round(sum(walkp.keepers) * 100 / max(sum(walkp.shots), 1)), "% keeper rate"
section "Walks per week", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, count(walkp week of (today - 7 * (8 - it))), join("W", it)
section "Places"
  share walkp sort keepers desc top 5, it.keepers, it.place
section "Best walk", "most keepers"
  each walkp sort keepers desc top 1 as w empty "No walks yet."
    row gap 2
      w.place bold grow
      w.keepers "keepers" faint
section "Walk days", "last 10 weeks"
  heat last 70 days, count(walkp on it), 1
section "Since the last walk"
  since(walkp) big
  "days ago" faint
section "All walks"
  list walkp by day, "No walks yet. Take the camera for twenty minutes around your street."
row gap 2
  statcard count(walkp week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(walkp prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(walkp) "entries so far" big

  "Last one" since(walkp) "days ago" faint

  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(walkp where dayname(at) = it), it

program_before:
app "Clinic Queue" heart teal
table patient name text, reason pick Fever|Checkup|Injury|Child|Other = Checkup, status pick Waiting|With_doctor|Done = Waiting, fee money = 500
setting capacity num = 40 "Patients a day"
state tab pick Waiting|With_doctor|Done = Waiting
topbar patient, "Add patient"
goal count(patient today), capacity, "patients seen or waiting today", "patients"
row gap 2
  stat count(patient where status = Waiting), "waiting now"
  stat count(patient today where status = Done), "done today"
  stat sum(patient.fee today where status = Done), "fees collected"
row gap 1
  each options patient.status as s
    button s count(patient today where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each patient today where status = tab sort at as p empty "Nobody in this list right now."
  row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
    text index + 1 bold
    stack grow gap 0
      p.name bold
      p.reason faint
    if p.status = Waiting
      button "Call in" tap set p.status = With_doctor
    if p.status = With_doctor
      button "Done" tap set p.status = Done
section "Patients per day", "last 14 days"

request: new idea, the app should show a section called "Passengers per route" and the small note "this week" that contains a breakdown of ticket by route showing how many there are this week above the "Takings per route" card, keep everything else the same
program_before:
app "Bus Seats" bus ocean
table ticket seat num 1..40, name text, fare money, route pick Lahore|Multan|Faisalabad = Lahore
setting price money = 1500 "Standard fare"
setting target money = 40000 "Daily takings target"
state r pick Lahore|Multan|Faisalabad = Lahore
let sold = count(ticket today where route = r)
topbar ticket, "Sell ticket"
choice r
statcard sold, "of 40 seats sold today for this route", 40
section "Seat map", "tap a free seat to sell it at the standard fare"
  grid 8 gap 1
    each 1..40 as n
      if count(ticket today where route = r and seat = n) = 0
        box height 34 radius 6 fill soft tap add ticket seat = n, name = "Walk-in", fare = price, route = r
          n small align center
      else
        box height 34 radius 6 fill accent
          n small align center color bg
row gap 2
  stat sum(ticket.fare today), "takings today"
  stat count(ticket today), "passengers today"
  stat 40 - sold, "seats still free"
goal sum(ticket.fare today), target, "of the daily takings target"
section "Takings", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(ticket.fare on it), target
section "Takings per route", "this month"
  bars ticket month by route, sum(it.fare), it.key
section "Passengers today", plural(count(ticket today), "ticket")
  each ticket today sort seat as t empty "No tickets sold yet today. Tap a seat to sell the first one."
    row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
      "Seat" t.seat bold
      stack grow gap 0
        t.name bold
        t.route faint
      t.fare bold
section "Fare check", "this week"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(ticket.fare week), "takings"
    stat round(sum(ticket.fare week) / max(count(ticket week), 1)), "average fare"
if sum(ticket.fare today) >= target
  "Target reached for today." color good bold

table sale cups num 1..500
setting limit money = 4000 "Weekly waste limit"
let wasted = sum(waste.cost week)
topbar waste, "Log waste"
goal wasted, limit, "waste cost this week"
row gap 2
  stat sum(waste.cost today), "wasted today"
  stat count(waste week), "items binned"
  stat round(wasted * 100 / max(sum(sale.cups week), 1)) / 100, "waste per cup sold"
section "Waste per day", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, sum(waste.cost on it), limit / 7
section "Why it happens", "cost this month"
  share waste month by reason, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Items that waste most", "cost this month"
  bars waste month by item, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Cups sold", "so we can compare"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(sale.cups on it)
  form sale, "Add cups sold"
section "Most costly item this week"
  each waste week sort cost desc top 3 as w empty "Nothing wasted this week."
    row card gap 2 tap edit w swipe remove w
      stack grow gap 0
        w.item bold
        w.reason faint
      w.cost bold color bad
if wasted > limit
  "Over the weekly limit. Check the fridge labels." color bad bold
list waste today, "Nothing wasted today. Good work."
section "Waste per item", "this week"
  each options waste.item as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(waste.cost week where item = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(waste.cost week where item = v) / max(sum(waste.cost week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Waste this week", "compared with last week"
  row gap 2
    stat wasted, "this week"
    stat sum(waste.cost prev week), "last week"

app "Juice Bar" cup orange
table sale drink pick Orange|Mango|Sugarcane|Carrot|Mix = Orange, price money = 150
setting target money = 12000 "Daily takings target"

"Juice Bar" head
choice flavour
quick sale, price, [100, 150, 200, 250]
button "Sell a" flavour "for 150" tap add sale drink = flavour, price = 150
statcard sum(sale.price today), "taken today of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat count(sale today), "glasses today"
  stat count(sale week), "glasses this week"
  stat round(sum(sale.price today) / max(count(sale today), 1)), "average per glass"

section "Flavours today"
  each options sale.drink as f
    row gap 2
      f bold grow
      count(sale today where drink = f) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 70
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(sale today where drink = f) / max(count(sale today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

  heat last 35 days, count(sale on it), 40
list sale today, "No sales yet today. Tap a price when the first glass goes."
section "Best day", "this month"
  stat max(days month, sum(sale.price on it)), "taken in one day"
section "Totals", "this month"
  row gap 2
    stat count(sale month), "glasses"
    stat sum(sale.price month), "takings"
if count(sale today) = 0
  "Quiet so far today. Set up the fruit." faint
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
  each sale top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.drink bold
