app "Copy Centre" note grey
table job kind pick Copies|Colour_print|Binding|Scan|Lamination = Copies, pages num 1..2000 = 10, price money, paid bool
table refill sheets num 100..5000 = 500
setting paper num = 2000 "Sheets at the start"
let left = paper + sum(refill.sheets) - sum(job.pages)
let owed = sum(job.price where paid = no)
topbar job, "Add job"
row gap 2
  stat sum(job.price today), "takings today"
  stat left, "sheets left"
  stat owed, "unpaid"
if left < 500
  "Paper is low. Buy a ream." color warn bold
goal sum(job.pages today), 400, "pages printed today", "pages"
section "Unpaid", "tick when the customer pays"
  each job where paid = no sort at as j empty "Everyone has paid. Nice."

      stack grow gap 0
        j.kind bold
        j.pages "pages" faint
      j.price bold

app "Goat Herd" paw orange
table goat tag text, sex pick Doe|Buck|Kid = Doe, status pick Healthy|Sick|Pregnant|Sold = Healthy

request: I need a section called "Paid so far" and the small note "this month" that contains a progress bar of the total amount from payment this month toward the target, captioned "of the monthly target" below the "By group" card
program_before:
app "Club Dues" users red
table member name text, group pick Juniors|Seniors|Veterans = Seniors
table payment member ref member, amount money = 2000
setting target money = 60000 "Monthly dues target"
let paid = count(member, count(it.payment month) > 0)
topbar member, "Add member"
statcard sum(payment.amount month), "collected of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat paid, "members paid"
  stat count(member) - paid, "still to pay"
  stat round(paid * 100 / max(count(member), 1)), "percent paid"
section "Members", "tick when paid"
  each member sort name as m empty "No members yet. Add the first player with Add member."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      toggle m.payment month
      stack grow gap 0
        m.name bold
        m.group faint
      if count(m.payment month) = 0
        "Due" faint color bad
section "Collected per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(payment.amount month of it), monthname(it)
section "By group", "this month"
  share member by group, count(it), it.key
section "Last payments", "newest first"
  each payment top 5 as p empty "No payments yet this month."
    row gap 2
      p.member.name bold grow
      p.at faint
      p.amount bold
section "Members by group"
  row gap 2
    each options member.group as g
      stat count(member where group = g), g
section "Paid per group", "this month"
  each options member.group as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(member where group = v and count(payment month) > 0) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(member where group = v and count(payment month) > 0) / max(count(member where group = v), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if count(member) - paid > 5
  "Many members are behind. Call them this week." color warn bold

app "Aquarium" fish teal
table test ph num 4..10, temp num 15..35 unit "C", ammonia num 0..5 = 0 unit "ppm"
table feed grams num 0..20 = 1 unit "g"
table change litres num 1..200 = 20 unit "L"
setting ph_low num = 6.8 "Lowest good pH"
setting ph_high num = 7.8 "Highest good pH"
topbar test, "Log test"
row gap 2
  statcard last(test.ph), "pH now"
  statcard last(test.temp), "degrees C now"
  statcard since(change), "days since water change"
if last(test.ph) < ph_low or last(test.ph) > ph_high
  "pH is outside the good range. Check the water." color warn bold
section "Feeding today", "meals:" count(feed today)
  row gap 1
    button "Feed 1 g" tap add feed grams = 1

  "Fed" sum(feed.grams today) "g today" faint
section "pH trend", "last 30 days"
  trend test last 30 days, it.ph
section "Temperature trend", "last 30 days"
  trend test last 30 days, it.temp
section "Water changes", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, sum(change.litres week of (today - 7 * (8 - it))), join("W", it)
  button "Changed 20 L" tap add change litres = 20
section "Ammonia", "keep it at zero"
  max(test.ammonia month) "ppm highest this month" big
section "Water tests"
  list test by day, "No tests yet. Test the water once a week."
row gap 2
  statcard count(test week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(test prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(test) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(test year) faint
  "Last one" since(test) "days ago" faint

  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(test where dayname(at) = it), it

  "Lowest" min(test.ph) faint

app "Pump Log" drop ocean

row gap 2
  stat sum(irrigate.hours today), "hours today"

app "Mandi Trades" paw grey
table trade animal pick Cow|Buffalo|Goat|Calf|Bull = Goat, weight num 20..900 = 100 unit "kg", bought money, sold money = 0, status pick Holding|Sold = Holding

let profit = sum(trade month where status = Sold, it.sold - it.bought) - sum(feedcost.amount month)

row gap 2
  stat count(trade where status = Holding), "in the yard"
  stat sum(trade.bought where status = Holding), "money tied up"
  stat count(trade month where status = Sold), "sold this month"

        t.weight "kg, bought for" t.bought faint

program_before:
app "Book Club" book plum
table book title text, author text?, pages num 20..1500 = 250, status pick Proposed|Reading|Finished = Proposed
table vote book ref book
table reading book ref book, pages num 1..300 = 20
setting weekly num = 100 "Pages to read each week"
state tab pick Proposed|Reading|Finished = Proposed
topbar book, "Propose book"
goal sum(reading.pages week), weekly, "pages read this week", "pages"
row gap 1
  each options book.status as s
    button s count(book where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each book where status = tab sort title as b empty "No books in this list. Propose one for the next meeting."
  stack card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    row gap 2
      stack grow gap 0
        b.title bold
        b.author b.pages "pages" faint
      if b.status = Proposed
        button "Vote" count(b.vote) tap add vote book = b
      if b.status = Proposed
        button "Start" tap set b.status = Reading
      if b.status = Reading
        button "Finished" tap set b.status = Finished
    if b.status = Reading
      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(b.reading.pages) / b.pages, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Votes", "proposed books"
  bars book where status = Proposed sort count(it.vote) desc top 5, count(it.vote), it.title
section "Log reading"
  form reading, "Save pages"
section "Finished books", count(book where status = Finished)
  stat sum(book.pages where status = Finished), "pages read together"
section "Most pages", "longest proposed book"
  each book where status = Proposed sort pages desc top 2 as b empty "No proposals."
    row gap 2
      b.title bold grow
      b.pages "pages" faint
section "Reading streak"
  row gap 2
    stat streak(reading), "days in a row"
    stat best(reading), "best streak"
    stat sum(reading.pages month), "pages this month"
if sum(reading.pages week) >= weekly
  "Weekly reading goal reached." color good bold

app "Shaadi Catering" gift plum
table event client text, date date, guests num 20..2000 = 200, rate money, advance money = 0, kind pick Wedding|Walima|Mehndi|Birthday|Corporate = Wedding

topbar event, "Book event"

row gap 2
  stat count(event where date >= today and date <= today + 7), "events this week"

goal sum(event.guests where date >= today and date <= today + 7), heads, "of weekly capacity", "guests"

  each event where date >= today sort date top 6 as e empty "No upcoming events. Add the next booking."

      stack grow gap 0
        e.client e.kind bold
        e.date "-" e.guests "guests" faint
      stack gap 0 align end
        e.guests * e.rate - e.advance bold
        "balance" tiny faint
section "Events by kind", "all time"
  share event by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Revenue per month", "last 6 months"

section "Booked value", "all events"
  stat total, "total booked"
section "Guests per kind", "upcoming"
  each options event.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) faint

        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) / max(sum(event.guests where date >= today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

  each event top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."

app "Dairy Log" milk blue

setting goal num = 60 "Daily herd goal (L)"
state sh pick Morning|Evening = Morning
let today_l = sum(milk.litres today)
topbar milk, "Add milking"
statcard today_l, "litres today of" goal, goal

  stat sum(milk.litres week) * price, "earned this week"
section "Shift view"
  choice sh
  each options milk.cow as c
    row gap 2
      c bold grow
      sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 90
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) / 12, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

section "Best cows this month", "litres"

list milk today by day, "No milking logged today. Add the morning shift first."
section "Evening against morning", "this week"

    stat sum(milk.litres week where shift = Morning), "L morning"

section "Best day this month", "litres"
  stat max(days month, sum(milk.litres on it)), "L in one day"
section "Month income", "at the price per litre"

    stat sum(milk.litres month) * price, "earned"

    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) / max(sum(milk.litres week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if today_l >= goal
  "Daily goal reached." color good bold

table milk cow pick Gauri|Laali|Moti|Kali|Chandni = Gauri, litres num 1..20 = 8 unit "L", shift pick Morning|Evening = Morning
setting price money = 140 "Price per litre"
setting goal num = 60 "Daily herd goal (L)"
state sh pick Morning|Evening = Morning
let today_l = sum(milk.litres today)
topbar milk, "Add milking"
statcard today_l, "litres today of" goal, goal
row gap 2
  stat today_l * price, "earned today"
  stat sum(milk.litres week) * price, "earned this week"
section "Shift view"
  choice sh
  each options milk.cow as c
    row gap 2
      c bold grow
      sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 90
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) / 12, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Last 7 days", "average" round(sum(milk.litres last 7 days) / 7) "L a day"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(milk.litres on it), goal
section "Best cows this month", "litres"
  share milk month by cow, sum(it.litres), it.key
list milk today by day, "No milking logged today. Add the morning shift first."
section "Evening against morning", "this week"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres week where shift = Morning), "L morning"
    stat sum(milk.litres week where shift = Evening), "L evening"
section "Litres per day", "last 14 days"
  trend days last 14 days, sum(milk.litres on it)
section "Best day this month", "litres"
  stat max(days month, sum(milk.litres on it)), "L in one day"
section "Month income", "at the price per litre"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres month) * price, "earned"
    stat round(sum(milk.litres month) / max(count(days month, count(milk on it) > 0), 1)), "L a day"
section "Milk per shift", "this week"
  each options milk.shift as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) / max(sum(milk.litres week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if today_l >= goal
  "Daily goal reached." color good bold

table game p1 ref player, p2 ref player, result pick First_won|Draw|Second_won = Draw, moves num 5..200 = 40 "Moves played"
setting rounds num = 10 "Games each player should play"
let pts(p player) = count(game where p1 = p and result = First_won) + count(game where p2 = p and result = Second_won) + count(game where (p1 = p or p2 = p) and result = Draw) / 2
let played(p player) = count(game where p1 = p or p2 = p)
"Chess Club" head
statcard count(game), "games played by" plural(count(player), "player"), count(player) * rounds / 2
section "Standings", "points: win 1, draw half"
  each player sort pts(it) desc as p empty "No players yet. Add the members below."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      text index + 1 bold
      p.name bold grow
      played(p) "games" faint
      pts(p) big
section "Points", "top 5"
  bars player sort pts(it) desc top 5, pts(it), it.name
section "Games per week", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, count(game week of it), monthday(it)
section "Results", "all games"
  share game by result, count(it), it.key
section "Latest games"
  each game top 5 as g empty "No games yet. Record the first result."
    row gap 2
      g.p1.name bold grow
      "vs" faint
      g.p2.name bold grow
      g.result faint
form player, "Add player"
form game, "Record game"
section "Games played", "per player"
  each player sort name as p
    row gap 2
      p.name bold grow
      played(p) "of" rounds faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(played(p) / max(rounds, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Draw rate"
  goal count(game where result = Draw), max(count(game), 1), "games drawn", "draws"

app "Price Per Kg" scale mint
state p1 money = 1450
state w1 num = 5
state u1 pick Kg|Grams = Kg
state p2 money = 320
state w2 num = 900
state u2 pick Kg|Grams = Grams
let kg1 = if(u1 = Grams, w1 / 1000, w1)
let kg2 = if(u2 = Grams, w2 / 1000, w2)

row gap 2

    field w1 "Weight"
    choice u1
  stack grow gap 1
    "Pack two" bold
    field p2 "Price"
    field w2 "Weight"
    choice u2
row gap 2

  statcard round(c2), "per kg, pack two"
if c1 > 0 and c2 > 0
  if c1 < c2
    "Pack one is cheaper by" round(c2 - c1) "per kg." bold color good
  else
    if c2 < c1
      "Pack two is cheaper by" round(c1 - c2) "per kg." bold color good
    else
      "Both cost the same per kg." faint

program_before:
app "Solar payback" sun purple
state kw num = 5
state cost money = 150000
state sun num = 4
state tariff money = 40
state loss num = 0.5
let yearly = kw * sun * 365 * tariff
let paid_back = cost * kw / max(yearly, 1)
let left10 = pow(1 - loss / 100, 10)
section "Your system"
  "Size" kw "kW" faint
  slider kw 1..20
  field cost "Cost per kW"
  "Sun hours (units per kW a day)" sun faint
  slider sun 2..6
  field tariff "What you pay per unit"
  "Panel loss per year" loss "%" faint
  slider loss 0..2
if yearly = 0
  "Fill in the prices to see how fast it pays back." faint
else
  statcard round(paid_back * 10) / 10, "years to pay back"
  row gap 2
    stat round(yearly), "saved in year one"
    stat round(left10 * 100), "% output after 10 years"
  section "Total saved over 10 years", "minus cost"
    trend 1..10, yearly * it - cost * kw

    "Zakat due" round(due * 1000) / 1000 "tola" head
    "About" round(due * rate) "rupees at today's price" faint

    "Below 7.5 tola of pure gold. No zakat on this gold." color good bold

app "Journal" book slate
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
"How are you feeling?" head
row gap 1
  each ["Awful", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
    stack grow align center tap set d.mood = index + 1
      draw width 44
        circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft)
        rect 30, 74 - 12 * index, 40, 8 + 12 * index fill bg radius 3
      it tiny
field d.note "What is on your mind?"
button "Save entry" tap save d
row gap 2
  stat streak(entry), if(count(entry today) > 0, "day streak, including today", "day streak; write today to keep it")
  stat count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0), "of 14 days written"
row gap 1
  each days last 14 days
    box grow height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(entry on it) > 0, accent, soft)
"Mood this week" round(avg(entry.mood week)) "vs" round(avg(entry.mood prev week)) "last week" faint
trend entry last 30 days sort at, it.mood
state q text = ""
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
list entry where has(note, q) by day

app "Court Booking" ball red
table booking player text, court pick Court_1|Court_2|Court_3 = Court_1, slot pick Six_pm|Seven_pm|Eight_pm|Nine_pm = Six_pm, day date = today, fee money = 1200
setting slots num = 12 "Slots available a day"
state d date = today
let taken = count(booking where day = d)
topbar booking, "Book court"
row gap 1 align center
  button "<" tap set d = d - 1
  d bold grow align center
  button ">" tap set d = d + 1
goal taken, slots, "slots booked on this day", "slots"
section "Slot grid", "tap a free slot for a quick booking"
  each options booking.court as c
    row gap 1
      c bold width 70
      each options booking.slot as s
        if count(booking where day = d and court = c and slot = s) = 0
          box height 40 radius 6 fill soft grow tap add booking player = "Walk-in", court = c, slot = s, day = d
            s tiny align center
        else
          box height 40 radius 6 fill accent grow
            s tiny align center color bg
row gap 2
  stat sum(booking.fee where day = d), "income this day"
  stat slots - taken, "free slots"

request: One thing: label the area with the list as Records, just that.
program_before:
app "Gym Pro" dumbbell slate
table member name text, fee money, due date, ends date
table checkin member ref member
table trainer who text, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun, start time
"Check-ins today" count(checkin today) big
"Fees due" head
each member where due <= today sort due
  row card
    it.name grow
    it.fee bold color bad
"Memberships ending in 14 days" head
each member where ends - today <= 14 and ends >= today sort ends
  row card
    it.name grow
    it.ends color warn
"Members" head
each member sort name
  row card
    it.name grow
    button "Check in" tap add checkin member = it
    button "Paid" tap set it.due = addmonths(it.due, 1)
"Trainer schedule" head
each trainer sort start
  row card tap edit it
    it.day it.start it.who
form member, "Add member"
form trainer, "Add trainer slot"

app "Kiryana Store" cart slate
table item name text, unit pick Kg|Packet|Dozen|Litre = Packet, cost money, price money, qty num 0.. = 20, low num 0.. = 5
table sale item ref item, qty num 1..100 = 1
setting target money = 3000 "Daily profit goal"
let profit_on(d date) = sum(sale on d, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost))
let profit = sum(sale today, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost))
topbar item, "Add item"
statcard profit, "profit today of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat sum(sale today, it.qty * it.item.price), "sales today"
  stat count(sale today), "items sold"
  stat count(item, it.qty <= it.low), "running low"
section "Shelf", "tap Sell for one unit"
  each item sort name as i empty "The shelf is empty. Add your first item with Add item."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      stack grow gap 0
        i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
        i.price "per" i.unit "- margin" i.price - i.cost faint
      i.qty bold
      button "Sell" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1 then add sale item = i
section "Profit per day", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, profit_on(it), target
section "Best earners", "profit this month"
  bars sale month by item.name, sum(it, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost)), it.key
section "Stock by unit"
  each options item.unit as u
    row gap 2
      u bold grow
      sum(item.qty where unit = u) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(item.qty where unit = u) / max(sum(item.qty), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Reorder today", "at or below the low level"
  each item where qty <= low sort qty as i empty "Nothing to reorder today."
    row gap 2
      i.name bold grow
      i.qty "left of" i.low faint color warn
section "This month"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(sale month, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost)), "profit"
    stat sum(sale.qty month), "units sold"
if profit >= target
  "Daily profit goal reached." color good bold

table sale item ref item, qty num 1..100 = 1
setting target money = 3000 "Daily profit goal"
let profit_on(d date) = sum(sale on d, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost))
let profit = sum(sale today, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost))
topbar item, "Add item"
statcard profit, "profit today of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat sum(sale today, it.qty * it.item.price), "sales today"
  stat count(sale today), "items sold"
  stat count(item, it.qty <= it.low), "running low"
section "Shelf", "tap Sell for one unit"
  each item sort name as i empty "The shelf is empty. Add your first item with Add item."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      stack grow gap 0
        i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
        i.price "per" i.unit "- margin" i.price - i.cost faint
      i.qty bold
      button "Sell" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1 then add sale item = i
section "Profit per day", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, profit_on(it), target
section "Best earners", "profit this month"
  bars sale month by item.name, sum(it, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost)), it.key
section "Stock by unit"
  each options item.unit as u
    row gap 2
      u bold grow
      sum(item.qty where unit = u) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(item.qty where unit = u) / max(sum(item.qty), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Reorder today", "at or below the low level"
  each item where qty <= low sort qty as i empty "Nothing to reorder today."
    row gap 2
      i.name bold grow
      i.qty "left of" i.low faint color warn
section "This month"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(sale month, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost)), "profit"
    stat sum(sale.qty month), "units sold"
if profit >= target
  "Daily profit goal reached." color good bold

table sub customer text, plan pick Starter|Pro|Team = Starter, mrr money, status pick Active|Trial|Churned = Trial

table habit name text

          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
remind "Check your habits" at 20:00
form habit

app "Outer paint" pencil plum
state wide num = 60
state high num = 12
state wins num = 6
state coats num = 2
setting primer money = 650 "Primer per litre"
setting paint money = 1400 "Paint per litre"
setting labour money = 14 "Painter per sq ft"
let area = max(wide * high - wins * 15, 0)
let p_lit = area / 90
let c_lit = area * coats / 80
section "Walls (feet)"
  field wide "Total wall length"
  field high "Height"
  field wins "Windows and doors"
  "Paint coats" coats faint
  slider coats 1..3
if area = 0
  "Enter the wall size." faint
else
  statcard area, "sq ft to paint"
  row gap 2
    stat round(p_lit * 10) / 10, "litres of primer"
    stat round(c_lit * 10) / 10, "litres of paint"
  section "Job cost"
    "Materials" round(p_lit * primer + c_lit * paint) faint
    "Labour" round(area * labour) faint
    "Total" round(p_lit * primer + c_lit * paint + area * labour) big

app "Tank fill" cup slate
state shape pick Round|Box = Round
state wide num = 4
state high num = 5
state long num = 4
state level num = 20
state flow num = 40
state kw num = 0.75
setting rate money = 35 "Price per unit"
let cubic = if(shape = Round, pi * pow(wide / 2, 2) * high, wide * long * high)
let litres = cubic * 28.32
let need = litres * (100 - level) / 100
let mins = need / max(flow, 1)
row gap 1
  choice shape
section "Tank"
  if shape = Round
    field wide "Diameter (ft)"
  else
    field wide "Width (ft)"
    field long "Length (ft)"
  field high "Height (ft)"
  "Full now" level "%" faint
  slider level 0..100
  field flow "Pump flow (litres a minute)"
statcard round(litres), "litres when full"
if level >= 100
  "The tank is already full." big color good
else
  "Time to fill" floor(mins / 60) "h" round(mins % 60) "min" big
  "Water to add" round(need) "litres" faint
  "Pump power cost" round(mins / 60 * kw * rate) faint

let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

    poly stroke accent thick 2

        if count(bp on it) > 0
          pt index, sum(bp.sys on it) / count(bp on it)
    poly stroke muted thick 2
      each days last 14 days
        if count(bp on it) > 0
          pt index, sum(bp.dia on it) / count(bp on it)
each bp sort at desc top 8 as b empty "Nothing here yet. Add a reading after you rest for five minutes."
  row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    b.sys "/" b.dia bold
    b.pulse "bpm" faint grow
    b.at faint

program_before:
app "Cloud Costs" cloud teal
table bill service pick Compute|Storage|Database|Network|Monitoring = Compute, amount money, note text?
setting budget money = 1200 "Monthly cloud budget"
state m date = today
let spent = sum(bill.amount month of m)
topbar bill, "Add bill"
monthnav m
statcard spent, "spent in" monthname(m) "of" budget, budget
if spent > budget
  "Over budget by" spent - budget color bad bold
section "By service", monthname(m)
  share bill month of m by service, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Spend per day", monthname(m)
  daybars month of m, sum(bill.amount on it)
section "Last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(bill.amount month of it), monthname(it)
section "Month on month", "this month and last"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(bill.amount month), "this month"
    stat sum(bill.amount prev month), "last month"
    stat sum(bill.amount month) - sum(bill.amount prev month), "change"
section "Biggest lines", "top 3"
  each bill month of m sort amount desc top 3 as b empty "No bills in this month."
    row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
      stack grow gap 0
        b.service bold
        b.note faint
      b.amount bold
list bill month of m by day, "No bills logged for this month."
section "Share of budget", "this month"
  each options bill.service as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(bill.amount month of m where service = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(bill.amount month of m where service = v) / max(budget, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Daily average", monthname(m)
  stat round(spent / max(monthdays(m), 1)), "spent per day"
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each bill top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.service bold
        x.note faint
      x.amount bold

      round(u3 * 100) / 100 bold

screen plan "Today" calendar
  count(task where done = no) "tasks left" head
  each appt where day = today sort at_time as a
    row card
      a.at_time bold
      a.what grow
  each task where done = no as t
    row card swipe remove t
      toggle t.done
      t.what grow
  form task, "Add task"
screen appts "Appointments" clock
  each appt where day >= today sort day as a
    row card tap edit a swipe remove a
      a.day a.at_time bold
      a.what grow
  form appt, "Add appointment"

app "Marks" school purple
table mark subject pick Maths|English|Science|Urdu|Islamiat|Computer = Maths, test text, score num 0..200, total num 1..200 = 100

let pct = round(sum(mark.score) * 100 / max(sum(mark.total), 1))
let failed = count(mark, it.score * 100 < pass_percent * it.total)
topbar mark, "Add mark"
row gap 2
  statcard pct, "% average over all tests", 100
  statcard count(mark), "tests recorded"
  statcard failed, "below the pass mark"
section "By subject", "average percent"
  each options mark.subject as s
    stack gap 0

      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(mark.score where subject = s) / max(sum(mark.total where subject = s), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Score over time", "percent per test"
  trend mark last 180 days, it.score * 100 / it.total
section "Tests per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, count(mark month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Best and weakest"
  "Best score" max(mark, it.score * 100 / it.total) "%" bold
  "Lowest score" min(mark, it.score * 100 / it.total) "%" faint
section "Latest tests"
  each mark top 8 as m empty "No marks yet. Add the first test result."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      stack grow gap 0
        m.test bold
        m.subject faint
      m.score "/" m.total bold

  statcard count(mark week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(mark prev week), "entries last week"

  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(mark where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Velocity" bolt mint
table story title text, points num 1..13 = 3, dev pick Ali|Sara|Bilal|Hina = Ali
table finished story ref story
setting commit num = 40 "Sprint commitment (points)"
let done_pts = sum(finished, it.story.points)
topbar story, "Add story"
goal done_pts, commit, "points finished this sprint", "pts"
row gap 2
  stat count(finished), "stories done"
  stat count(story) - count(finished), "stories left"
  stat sum(story.points) - done_pts, "points left"
section "Stories", "tick when done"
  each story sort at as s empty "No stories yet. Add the first one with Add story."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      toggle s.finished all
      stack grow gap 0
        s.title bold
        s.dev faint
      s.points "pts" bold
section "Points done per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(finished on it, it.story.points)
section "Points per developer", "finished"
  share finished by story.dev, sum(it, it.story.points), it.key
section "Load per developer"
  each options story.dev as d
    row gap 2
      d bold grow
      sum(story.points where dev = d) "pts" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(story.points where dev = d) / max(sum(story.points), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Working days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(finished on it), 3
section "Biggest stories left", "top 3"
  each story sort points desc top 3 as s
    row gap 2
      s.title bold grow
      s.points "pts" faint
if done_pts >= commit
  "Commitment met." color good bold

app "Pocket money" coin yellow

program_before:
app "Home repairs" tool slate
table job title text, room pick Kitchen|Bathroom|Bedroom|Roof|Garden|Other = Kitchen, status pick Todo|Doing|Done = Todo, cost money?, due date?
setting budget money = 50000 "Repair budget for the year"
state tab pick Todo|Doing|Done = Todo
let spent = sum(job.cost year where status = Done)
topbar job, "Add job"
row gap 2
  statcard count(job where status != Done), "open jobs"
  statcard spent, "spent this year, budget" budget, budget
row gap 1
  each options job.status as s
    button s count(job where status = s) fill if(tab = s, ink, surface) grow tap set tab = s
each job where status = tab sort due as j empty "No jobs here. Add the leaking tap, the cracked tile, the loose door."
  row card gap 2 tap edit j swipe remove j
    stack grow gap 0
      j.title bold
      j.room j.due faint
    j.cost faint
    if j.status = Todo
      button "Start" tap set j.status = Doing
    if j.status = Doing
      button "Done" fill accent tap set j.status = Done
section "Spend by room", "all done jobs"
  share job where status = Done by room, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Spend per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(job.cost month of addmonths(today, it - 6) where status = Done), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Overdue jobs"
  each job where status != Done and due < today sort due as j empty "Nothing overdue."
    row gap 2
      j.title grow
      "Late" today - j.due "days" color bad
section "Biggest job"
  max(job.cost) big
  "Jobs finished this year" count(job year where status = Done) faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(job week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(job prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(job) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(job year) faint
  "Last one" since(job) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(job where dayname(at) = it), it

setting budget money = 50000 "Repair budget for the year"
state tab pick Todo|Doing|Done = Todo
let spent = sum(job.cost year where status = Done)
topbar job, "Add job"
row gap 2
  statcard count(job where status != Done), "open jobs"
  statcard spent, "spent this year, budget" budget, budget
row gap 1
  each options job.status as s
    button s count(job where status = s) fill if(tab = s, ink, surface) grow tap set tab = s
each job where status = tab sort due as j empty "No jobs here. Add the leaking tap, the cracked tile, the loose door."
  row card gap 2 tap edit j swipe remove j
    stack grow gap 0
      j.title bold
      j.room j.due faint
    j.cost faint
    if j.status = Todo
      button "Start" tap set j.status = Doing
    if j.status = Doing
      button "Done" fill accent tap set j.status = Done
section "Spend by room", "all done jobs"
  share job where status = Done by room, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Spend per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(job.cost month of addmonths(today, it - 6) where status = Done), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Overdue jobs"
  each job where status != Done and due < today sort due as j empty "Nothing overdue."
    row gap 2
      j.title grow
      "Late" today - j.due "days" color bad
section "Biggest job"
  max(job.cost) big
  "Jobs finished this year" count(job year where status = Done) faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(job week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(job prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(job) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(job year) faint
  "Last one" since(job) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(job where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Crop Profit" plant green
state yield num = 40
state price money = 0
state seed money = 0
state fert money = 0
state water money = 0
state labour money = 0
state acres num = 5
let income = yield * price
let costs = seed + fert + water + labour
section "Income per acre"
  row gap 2
    field yield "Maunds"

section "Costs per acre", costs
  row gap 2
    field seed "Seed"
    field fert "Fertiliser"
  row gap 2
    field water "Water"
    field labour "Labour"
field acres "Acres"
if price > 0
  statcard round(income - costs), if(income >= costs, "profit per acre", "loss per acre")
  stat round((income - costs) * acres), "for all" plural(acres, "acre")
else
  "Type the price per maund to see the profit." faint

app "Care Circle" heart red
table carer name text, role pick Doctor|Nurse|Family|Neighbour|Pharmacy = Family, phone text

  section "Top number, last 30 readings"

  topbar carer, "Add person"
  each carer sort role as c empty "Add the doctor, the nurse and the family to call."

        c.name bold

app "Rent Book" home mint
table tenant name text, flat text, rent money
table paid tenant ref tenant, amount money
table repair what text, cost money
setting due_day num = 5 "Rent due on day"

let received = sum(paid.amount month)
topbar tenant, "Add tenant"
statcard received, "received of" expected, expected

  "Rent is late for" count(tenant, count(it.paid month) = 0) "tenants." color bad bold

  each tenant sort flat as t empty "No tenants yet. Add the first flat with Add tenant."
    row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t

      stack grow gap 0
        t.name bold
        "Flat" t.flat faint
      t.rent bold
section "Rent per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(paid.amount month of it), monthname(it)
section "Money in and out", "this month"
  row gap 2
    stat received, "rent in"
    stat sum(repair.cost month), "repairs"
    stat received - sum(repair.cost month), "kept"
section "Repairs"
  list repair top 4, "No repairs this month."
  form repair, "Add repair"
section "Rent by flat", "monthly"
  share tenant, it.rent, it.flat
section "Collected so far", "this month"
  goal received, max(expected, 1), "of the expected rent"
section "Biggest rents", "top 3"
  each tenant sort rent desc top 3 as t
    row gap 2
      t.name bold grow
      t.rent faint
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
  each tenant top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        "Flat" x.flat faint
      x.rent bold

app "Zakat and tip" calc slate
setting cash money = 5 "Cash and bank"
setting gold num = 0 "Gold (grams)"
setting silver num = 0 "Silver (grams)"

setting silver_rate money = 0 "Silver price per gram"
setting debts money = 0 "Debts due now"
state bill money = 0
state tip num = 10
state people num = 1
let wealth = cash + gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate - debts
let nisab = 612.36 * silver_rate
screen zakat "Zakat" coin
  field cash

  field silver

  field silver_rate

  field bill "Bill"

  slider tip 0..30

  slider people 1..20

  "Each pays" round(bill * (1 + tip / 100) / people) big

app "Plants" plant green
table plant name text, every num 1..30 = 7 unit "days", spot pick Kitchen|Bedroom|Balcony|Office = Kitchen
table watering plant ref plant, ml num 50..2000 = 250
setting default_ml num = 250 "Usual water (ml)"
let thirsty = count(plant, due(it.watering, it.every))
let litres = sum(watering.ml month) / 1000
topbar plant, "Add plant"
statcard thirsty, "plants need water today", count(plant)
section "Your plants", "total" count(plant)
  each plant sort name as p empty "No plants yet. Add the first one and set how often it drinks."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      stack grow gap 0
        p.name bold
        p.spot "every" p.every "days" faint
        if due(p.watering, p.every)
          "Thirsty" color warn small
        else
          "Watered" since(p.watering) "days ago" faint
      button "Watered" fill if(due(p.watering, p.every), accent, soft) tap add watering plant = p, ml = default_ml
section "Waterings per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(watering on it)
section "By room"
  share plant by spot, count(it), it.key
section "Most watered", "this month"
  share plant sort count(it.watering month) desc top 4, count(it.watering month), it.name
row gap 2
  stat fixed(litres, 1), "litres of water this month"
  stat count(watering week), "waterings this week"
section "Latest waterings"
  each watering top 6 as w empty "Nothing watered yet."
    row gap 2
      w.plant.name grow
      w.ml "ml" faint
      w.at faint
section "Skipped plants", "not watered for 10 days"
  each plant where since(watering) > 10 as p empty "Every plant has had a drink recently."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p
      p.name grow
      since(p.watering) "days" color warn
section "Water this week", "ml per day"
  bars days last 7 days, sum(watering.ml on it), dayname(it)
section "Care tip"
  "Water in the morning and feel the soil first. Touch the top two fingers deep." faint

app "Bike Cost per Km" bike green

state every num = 3000
state tyres money = 14000
state life num = 20000

  topbar fill, "Add fill-up"
  each fill top 5 as f empty "No fill-ups yet."
    row tap edit f swipe remove f
      f.litres "litres" grow
      f.paid bold

table blend name text, grams num

table sell mat pick Iron|Paper|Plastic|Copper = Iron, kg num 0.5..20000, rate money
let spent = sum(buy, it.kg * it.rate)
let earned = sum(sell, it.kg * it.rate)
stack card gap 1
  "Profit so far" faint
  earned - spent big color if(earned >= spent, good, bad)
  row
    "Bought" spent faint grow
    "Sold" earned faint
each options buy.mat
  row card gap 2
    it bold grow
    sum(buy.kg where mat = it) - sum(sell.kg where mat = it) "kg in stock" faint
screen buys "Buy" cart
  topbar buy, "Add purchase"
  each buy sort at desc as b empty "No purchases yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
      stack grow gap 0
        b.mat bold
        b.kg "kg at" b.rate faint
      b.kg * b.rate bold
screen sells "Sell" money
  topbar sell, "Add sale"
  each sell sort at desc as s empty "No sales yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.mat bold
        s.kg "kg at" s.rate faint
      s.kg * s.rate bold color good

app "Guest House" home ocean
table room name text, rate money
table stay room ref room, guest text, nights num 1..30 = 1, checkin date = today, paid bool
setting target num = 70 "Occupancy target (percent)"
let occupied(r room) = count(stay where room = r and checkin <= today and checkin + nights > today)
let busy = count(room, occupied(it) > 0)
topbar room, "Add room"
goal busy, max(count(room), 1), "rooms occupied tonight", "rooms"
row gap 2
  stat round(busy * 100 / max(count(room), 1)), "percent occupied, target" target
  stat sum(stay where paid = no, it.nights * it.room.rate), "unpaid stays"
  stat count(stay where checkin = today), "arrivals today"
section "Rooms tonight"
  grid 2 gap 1
    each room sort name as r empty "No rooms yet. Add your rooms with Add room."
      stack radius 10 pad 1 gap 0 fill if(occupied(r) > 0, accent, soft) tap edit r
        r.name bold color if(occupied(r) > 0, bg, ink)
        if(occupied(r) > 0, "Occupied", "Free") faint color if(occupied(r) > 0, bg, muted)
section "Check in a guest"
  form stay, "Check in"
section "Arriving soon", "next stays"
  each stay where checkin >= today sort checkin top 4 as s empty "No arrivals coming."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      toggle s.paid
      stack grow gap 0
        s.guest bold
        s.room.name "-" s.nights "nights" faint
      s.checkin faint
section "Income", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, sum(stay week of it, it.nights * it.room.rate), monthday(it)
section "Nights by room", "this month"
  share stay month by room.name, sum(it.nights), it.key
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each room top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        "Rate per night" faint
      x.rate bold

app "Sprint" target mint
table task title text, points num 1..13 = 3, owner pick Ali|Sara|Bilal|Hina = Ali, stage pick Todo|Doing|Review|Done = Todo
setting commit num = 40 "Points committed"
let done_pts = sum(task.points where stage = Done)
topbar task, "Add task"
goal done_pts, commit, "points done this sprint", "pts"
grid 2 gap 1
  each options task.stage as s
    stack card gap 1
      row
        s head grow
        sum(task.points where stage = s) "pts" faint
      each task where stage = s as t empty "Empty"
        stack radius 8 pad 1 fill soft gap 0 tap edit t swipe remove t
          t.title bold
          t.owner "-" t.points "pts" faint
section "Points done per person"
  bars task where stage = Done by owner, sum(it.points), it.key
section "Load per person", "all open work"
  share task where stage != Done by owner, sum(it.points), it.key
section "Tasks added", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(task on it)
section "Waiting for review", "stuck in the review column"
  each task where stage = Review as t empty "Nothing waiting for review."
    row gap 2
      t.title bold grow
      t.owner faint
      button "Merge" tap set t.stage = Done
section "Points left", "to hit the commitment"
  row gap 2
    stat commit - done_pts, "pts to go"
    stat sum(task.points where stage = Doing), "pts in progress"
    stat count(task), "tasks in all"
if done_pts >= commit
  "Commitment met. Pull one more task." color good bold
section "Points per person", "committed"
  each options task.owner as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(task.points where owner = v) "pts" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(task.points where owner = v) / max(commit / 4, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

setting stock money = 0 "Stock at market price"
setting till money = 0 "Cash and bank"
setting owed_in money = 0 "Customers owe me"
setting owed_out money = 0 "I owe suppliers"
setting silver money = 0 "Silver rate per gram"
let net = stock + till + owed_in - owed_out
let nisab = silver * 612.36
let due = if(nisab > 0 and net >= nisab, net * 0.025, 0)
row bar
  "Shop zakat" head grow
section "Business wealth"
  field stock
  field till
  field owed_in
  field owed_out
field silver
if nisab = 0

setting share money = 5000 "Share per member"
let pot = sum(pay.amount month)
let full = count(member) * share
let behind = count(member, count(it.pay month) = 0)
topbar member, "Add member"
statcard pot, "collected of" full, full

  "Takes the pot this month:" nth(member sort name, (month(today) - 1) % count(member) + 1).name bold
section "Members", "tick when the share is paid"
  each member sort name as m empty "No members yet. Add everyone in the committee."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      toggle m.pay month
      m.name bold grow
      if count(m.pay month) = 0
        "Due" color bad
      else
        "Paid" color good
section "Collection", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(pay.amount month of it), monthname(it)
row gap 2
  stat behind, "still to pay"
  stat count(member) - behind, "paid"
  stat max(full - pot, 0), "missing"
section "Payments by day", "this month"
  daybars month, sum(pay.amount on it)
section "Latest payments"
  each pay top 5 as p empty "No payments yet this month."
    row gap 2
      p.member.name bold grow
      p.amount faint
section "Paid share", "each member this month"
  each member sort name as m
    row gap 2
      m.name bold grow
      sum(m.pay.amount month) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(m.pay.amount month) / max(share, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

state front num = 30
state back num = 30
state left num = 60
state right num = 60

  row gap 1

setting tinted money = 260 "Tinted per sq ft"
setting frosted money = 300 "Frosted per sq ft"
setting mirror money = 350 "Mirror per sq ft"
state who text = ""
state kind pick Plain|Tinted|Frosted|Mirror = Plain
state w num = 36
state h num = 48
state n num = 1
let sqft = round(w * h * n / 144 * 10) / 10
let rate = if(kind = Plain, plain, if(kind = Tinted, tinted, if(kind = Frosted, frosted, mirror)))
topbar quote, "Add old quote"
choice kind
"Width" w "in" faint
slider w 6..120
"Height" h "in" faint
slider h 6..120
row gap 2 align center
  "Panes" n bold grow
  button "-" tap set n = max(n - 1, 1)
  button "+" tap set n = n + 1
statcard round(sqft * rate), "for" sqft "sq ft of" kind
field who "Customer name"
button "Save quote" fill accent tap add quote customer = who, glass = kind, sqft = sqft, total = round(sqft * rate) then set who = ""
list quote top 5, "No quotes saved yet."

table habit name text

each habit as h

state sa num = 500
state pa money = 0
state sb num = 750
state pb money = 0
state per pick Per_100|Per_1000 = Per_100
let k = if(per = Per_100, 100, 1000)
let ua = if(sa > 0, pa / sa * k, 0)
let ub = if(sb > 0, pb / sb * k, 0)
"Pack A" head
row gap 2
  field sa "Size"
  field pa "Price"
"Pack B" head
row gap 2
  field sb "Size"
  field pb "Price"
choice per
if pa > 0 and pb > 0
  statcard round(abs(ua - ub) * 100 / max(ua, ub)), if(ua = ub, "percent difference: same price", if(ua < ub, "percent cheaper: Pack A wins", "percent cheaper: Pack B wins"))
  row gap 2
    stat round(ub * 100) / 100, "pack B per unit group"
else
  "Enter both prices to see the winner." faint

table flash word text, meaning text
setting work dur = 25m "Focus length"
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
state sub ref subject
screen plan "Timetable" calendar
  each options lesson.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      dd bold
      each lesson where day = dd sort start as l
        row card tap edit l swipe remove l
          l.start l.subject.name grow
          l.mins "min"
  form lesson, "Add lesson"
  form subject, "Add subject"
screen focus "Focus" timer
  choice sub
  timer work, "Focus", add studied subject = sub, mins = 25 then notify "Break time"
  sum(studied.mins today) "min studied today" head
screen cards "Cards" cards
  each flash sort at as c
    if index = i
      stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
        if flipped
          c.meaning big
        else
          c.word big
  row gap 1
    button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
    button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  form flash, "Add card"
screen progress "Progress" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(studied.mins on it)
  share subject, sum(it.studied.mins week), it.name

request: something i noticed: can you move the "Present today per position" section down to the bottom?
program_before:
app "Club Squad" ball green
table player name text, position pick Keeper|Defender|Midfield|Striker = Midfield, shirt num 1..99 = 10 "Shirt number"
table present player ref player
setting minimum num = 11 "Players needed for a match"
let here = count(present today)
topbar player, "Add player"
goal here, minimum, "players at training today", "players"
if here >= minimum
  "Enough players for a match." color good bold
else
  "Need" minimum - here "more players today." color warn bold
section "Squad", "tap the tick when a player arrives"
  each player sort name as p empty "No players yet. Add the squad with Add player."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      toggle p.present
      stack grow gap 0
        p.name bold
        p.position faint
      count(p.present last 30 days) "of 30 days" faint
section "By position", "who is in today"
  row gap 1
    each options player.position as pos
      stack card grow gap 0 align center
        count(player where position = pos) bold
        pos faint
section "Attendance", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(present on it)
section "Most reliable", "days present in 30"
  bars player sort count(it.present last 30 days) desc top 5, count(it.present last 30 days), it.name
section "Training days", "last 6 weeks"
  daygrid last 42 days, count(present on it), max(count(player), 1)
section "Present today per position", "squad check"
  each options player.position as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(present today where player.position = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(present today where player.position = v) / max(count(player where position = v), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each player top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        x.position faint
      count(x.present last 30 days) "days" bold

app "Loan Compare" coin blue dark
state amt money = 1000000
state r1 num = 14
state y1 num = 3

    "Years" y2 faint

  statcard round(pay2), "per month, offer two"

if amt > 0
  if int1 < int2
    "Offer one costs" round(int2 - int1) "less overall." bold color good

app "Bike Hire" bike yellow
table rental rider text, bike pick City|Mountain|Electric = City, hours num 1..48 = 2 unit "h", rate money = 150, returned bool
setting fleet num = 12 "Bikes in the fleet"
let out = count(rental where returned = no)
topbar rental, "New rental"
goal out, fleet, "bikes out right now", "bikes"
row gap 2
  stat fleet - out, "bikes in the shop"
  stat sum(rental, it.hours * it.rate), "total rented value"
  stat sum(rental today, it.hours * it.rate), "income today"
section "Out now", "tick when the bike comes back"
  each rental where returned = no sort at as r empty "All bikes are back in the shop."
    row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
      toggle r.returned
      stack grow gap 0
        r.rider bold
        r.bike "-" r.hours "h at" r.rate faint
      r.hours * r.rate bold
section "Income by bike", "this month"
  share rental month by bike, sum(it, it.hours * it.rate), it.key
section "Rentals per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(rental on it)
section "Hours per bike type"
  each options rental.bike as b
    row gap 2
      b bold grow
      sum(rental.hours month where bike = b) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(rental.hours month where bike = b) / max(sum(rental.hours month), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Busy weekends", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(rental on it), 6
section "Returned", count(rental where returned = yes)
  list rental where returned = yes top 4, "Nothing returned yet."
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each rental top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.rider bold
        x.bike faint
      x.hours "h" bold

request: Listen, the order should have the "Sell scrap" section ahead of the "Latest sales" section
program_before:
app "Scrap Yard" tool teal
table buy item pick Iron|Copper|Paper|Plastic|Aluminium = Iron, kg num 1..2000 = 50 unit "kg", rate money
table sold item pick Iron|Copper|Paper|Plastic|Aluminium = Iron, kg num 1..5000 = 100 unit "kg", rate money
setting capacity num = 3000 "Yard capacity (kg)"
let stock = sum(buy.kg) - sum(sold.kg)
let margin = sum(sold, it.kg * it.rate) - sum(buy, it.kg * it.rate)
topbar buy, "Log purchase"
goal stock, capacity, "kg in the yard", "kg"
row gap 2
  stat sum(buy today, it.kg * it.rate), "bought today"
  stat sum(sold today, it.kg * it.rate), "sold today"
  stat margin, "margin so far"
section "Stock by metal", "bought minus sold"
  each options buy.item as m
    row gap 2
      m bold grow
      sum(buy.kg where item = m) - sum(sold.kg where item = m) "kg" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp((sum(buy.kg where item = m) - sum(sold.kg where item = m)) / max(capacity / 3, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Kilos bought per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(buy.kg on it)
section "Spend by metal", "this month"
  share buy month by item, sum(it, it.kg * it.rate), it.key
section "Sell scrap"
  form sold, "Save sale"
section "Latest sales"
  each sold top 4 as s empty "Nothing sold yet. Record the first load."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.item bold
        s.kg "kg at" s.rate faint
      s.kg * s.rate bold
section "Latest purchases"
  list buy top 4, "Nothing bought yet. Log the first purchase."
if stock > capacity
  "The yard is over capacity. Sell something." color warn bold
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each buy top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.item bold
        x.kg "kg" faint
      x.kg * x.rate bold

table member name text, group pick Juniors|Seniors|Veterans = Seniors

app "Mandi Trades" paw grey
table trade animal pick Cow|Buffalo|Goat|Calf|Bull = Goat, weight num 20..900 = 100 unit "kg", bought money, sold money = 0, status pick Holding|Sold = Holding
table feedcost animal text, amount money
setting target money = 120000 "Monthly profit goal"
let profit = sum(trade month where status = Sold, it.sold - it.bought) - sum(feedcost.amount month)
topbar trade, "Buy animal"
statcard profit, "profit this month of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat count(trade where status = Holding), "in the yard"
  stat sum(trade.bought where status = Holding), "money tied up"
  stat count(trade month where status = Sold), "sold this month"
section "In the yard", "tap Close deal when sold"
  each trade where status = Holding sort at as t empty "The yard is empty. Add the next animal you buy."
    row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
      stack grow gap 0
        t.animal bold
        t.weight "kg, bought for" t.bought faint
      button "Close deal" tap edit t
section "Profit by animal", "sold this month"
  bars trade month where status = Sold by animal, sum(it, it.sold - it.bought), it.key
section "Deals per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(trade on it)
section "Weight bought", "last 7 days"
  trend days last 7 days, sum(trade.weight on it)
section "Feed and medicine", "this month"
  stat sum(feedcost.amount month), "spent so far"
  each feedcost top 3 as f empty "No feed costs yet. Add one below."
    row gap 2
      f.animal bold grow
      f.amount faint
form feedcost, "Add feed cost"
section "Sold", count(trade where status = Sold)
  list trade where status = Sold top 6, "No animals sold yet."
if profit >= target
  "Monthly goal reached." color good bold
section "Animals in the yard", "by kind"
  each options trade.animal as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(trade where animal = v and status = Holding) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(trade where animal = v and status = Holding) / max(count(trade where status = Holding), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

app "My Journal" book plum
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
"How are you feeling?" head
row gap 1

    stack grow align center tap set d.mood = index + 1
      draw width 44
        circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft)
        rect 30, 74 - 12 * index, 40, 8 + 12 * index fill bg radius 3
      it tiny
field d.note "What is on your mind?"
button "Save entry" tap save d
row gap 2
  stat streak(entry), if(count(entry today) > 0, "day streak, including today", "day streak; write today to keep it")
  stat count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0), "of 14 days written"
row gap 1
  each days last 14 days
    box grow height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(entry on it) > 0, accent, soft)
"Mood this week" round(avg(entry.mood week)) "vs" round(avg(entry.mood prev week)) "last week" faint
trend entry last 30 days sort at, it.mood
state q text = ""
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
list entry where has(note, q) by day
"Saved on this device only." faint

let planned = count(plan)

topbar plan, "Plan a dish"
row gap 1

    button d fill if(pick_day = d, accent, soft) tap set pick_day = d
section "Meals on" pick_day, "planned:" count(plan where day = pick_day)
  each plan where day = pick_day sort slot as p empty "Nothing planned for this day. Tap Plan a dish."

      stack grow gap 0
        p.dish bold
        p.slot faint
      p.cost faint
section "The whole week", "dishes per day"

  each plan where cost > 0 sort cost top 3 as p empty "Add costs to dishes to see this."
    row gap 2
      p.dish grow
      p.cost bold

  "dishes this week" faint

  statcard count(plan prev week), "entries last week"

  "This year" count(plan year) faint
  "Last one" since(plan) "days ago" faint

  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(plan where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Body" scale slate
table body kg num 20..250 unit "kg", waist num? 40..200 unit "cm", chest num? 40..200 unit "cm"

let change = last(body.kg) - first(body.kg)
topbar body, "Add entry"
row gap 2
  statcard now_kg, "kg now"
  statcard round(change * 10) / 10, "kg change since the first entry"
section "Weight", "all entries"
  trend body, it.kg
section "Toward the target", "now" now_kg "kg of" target_kg "kg"
  goal now_kg, max(now_kg, target_kg), "kg now", "kg"
  "Still to go" round(abs(now_kg - target_kg) * 10) / 10 "kg" faint

section "Lowest and highest"

  "Highest" max(body.kg) "kg" faint
section "Weigh-in streak"
  since(body) big

program_before:
app "Grocery Prices" cart pink
table price item text, shop text?, cost money
state sel text = ""
topbar price, "Add price"
section "Pick an item", "tap to compare"
  row gap 1
    each price by item as g empty "No prices yet. Add what you paid for an item."
      button g.key fill if(sel = g.key, accent, soft) tap set sel = g.key
if sel != ""
  stack card gap 2
    sel head
    row gap 3
      stack gap 0
        "Last paid" faint
        last(price.cost where item = sel) bold
      stack gap 0
        "Lowest" faint
        min(price.cost where item = sel) bold color good
      stack gap 0
        "Highest" faint
        max(price.cost where item = sel) bold color bad
    trend price where item = sel, it.cost
each price where sel = "" or item = sel sort at desc top 15 as p empty "Nothing for this item yet."
  row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
    stack grow gap 0
      p.item bold
      p.shop faint
    p.cost bold

app "Fasting Window" hourglass ink
table fastlog hrs num 0..72
setting aim num = 16 "Fasting goal (hours)"
state started when = now
state fasting bool = no
let hrs_now = floor((now - started) / 1h)
if fasting
  stack card gap 2
    "Fasting for" faint
    hrs_now "h" big
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(hrs_now / aim, 0, 1), 4 fill if(hrs_now >= aim, good, accent) radius 2

app "Dukaan udhaar" bag red
table udhaar name text, amount money, due date, paid bool
remind "Udhaar wasool karna hai" at udhaar.due
"Baqi" sum(udhaar.amount where paid = no) big
each udhaar where paid = no sort due as u
  row card gap 2 tap edit u swipe remove u
    toggle u.paid
    stack grow gap 0
      u.name bold
      u.due faint color if(u.due < today, bad, muted)
    u.amount bold
form udhaar, "Udhaar likho"

let n = floor(24 / gap)

let firstm = hour(first) * 60 + minute(first)

program_before:
app "Budget" wallet purple
table flow what text, amount money, type pick In|Out = Out
state m date = today
let inc = sum(flow.amount month of m where type = In)
let out = sum(flow.amount month of m where type = Out)
topbar flow, "Add money in or out"
monthnav m
statcard inc - out, "left this month, in" inc ", out" out, inc

table roll label text, stock text, frames num 12..36 = 36, stage pick Loaded|Shot|Developed|Scanned = Loaded
topbar roll, "Add roll"
grid 4 gap 1
  each options roll.stage as s
    stack card gap 0 align center
      count(roll where stage = s) big
      s tiny
statcard sum(roll.frames where stage != Loaded), "frames shot in total"
each roll sort stage as r empty "No rolls yet. Load the first one."
  row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
    stack grow gap 0
      r.label bold
      r.stock r.frames "frames" faint
    if r.stage = Loaded
      button "Shot" tap set r.stage = Shot
    if r.stage = Shot
      button "Developed" tap set r.stage = Developed
    if r.stage = Developed
      button "Scanned" tap set r.stage = Scanned
    if r.stage = Scanned
      "Done" color good bold

short "products running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each product_s where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
form product_s
remind "Check your products" at 9:00 on sat

program_before:
app "Load tests" bolt orange dark
table lt rps num 1.., p95 num 0.. "p95 latency" unit "ms", errs num 0..100 = 0 "Errors" unit "%"
setting budget num = 300 "p95 budget (ms)"
topbar lt, "Log run"
row gap 2
  statcard count(lt where p95 > budget), "runs over budget"
if count(lt) > 1
  section "p95 over runs", "budget" budget "ms"
    trend lt, it.p95
each lt as r empty "No load tests yet. Log the first run after the next test."
  row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
    stack grow gap 0
      r.rps "rps" bold
      r.errs "% errors" faint
    r.p95 "ms" bold color if(r.p95 > budget, bad, ink)

app "Kameti" users green
table member name text, share money
table pay member ref member, amount money
let pot = sum(member.share)
topbar member, "Add member"
row gap 2
  statcard pot, "pot this month"
  statcard sum(pay.amount month), "collected so far", pot
each member sort name as m empty "No members yet. Add each member with their monthly share."
  let paid = sum(m.pay.amount month)
  row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
    stack grow gap 0
      m.name bold
      if paid >= m.share
        "paid" faint color good
      else
        "owes" m.share - paid faint color bad
    if paid < m.share
      button "Paid" tap add pay member = m, amount = m.share - paid

table sym eyes pick None|Mild|Bad = None, sneeze pick None|Mild|Bad = None, nose pick None|Mild|Bad = None, pollen pick Low|Medium|High = Medium, tablet bool
let score(s sym) = if(s.eyes = Bad, 1, 0) + if(s.sneeze = Bad, 1, 0) + if(s.nose = Bad, 1, 0)
topbar sym, "Log today"
row gap 2
  statcard count(days month, count(sym on it where eyes = Bad or sneeze = Bad or nose = Bad) > 0), "bad days this month"
  statcard count(sym week where tablet = yes), "tablets this week"
section "Last 5 weeks", "darker is worse"
  daygrid last 35 days, max(sym on it, score(it)), 3
each sym sort at desc top 10 as s empty "No entries yet. Add one each evening in pollen season."
  row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
    stack grow gap 0
      "Eyes" s.eyes "· Sneeze" s.sneeze "· Nose" s.nose bold
      "Pollen" s.pollen faint
    if s.tablet
      icon pill

table mock role text?, comm num 1..5 = 3 "Communication", tech num 1..5 = 3 "Technical depth", solve num 1..5 = 3 "Problem solving"
topbar mock, "Log mock"
statcard count(mock), "mock interviews done"
section "Where I am strong", "averages out of 5"
  draw 100, 100 height 220
    poly stroke soft thick 1
      pt 50, 6
      pt 50 + 44 * sin(120), 50 - 44 * cos(120)
      pt 50 + 44 * sin(240), 50 - 44 * cos(240)
      pt 50, 6
    poly stroke accent thick 2
      pt 50, 50 - 44 * avg(mock.comm) / 5
      pt 50 + 44 * sin(120) * avg(mock.tech) / 5, 50 - 44 * cos(120) * avg(mock.tech) / 5
      pt 50 + 44 * sin(240) * avg(mock.solve) / 5, 50 - 44 * cos(240) * avg(mock.solve) / 5
      pt 50, 50 - 44 * avg(mock.comm) / 5
    label 50, 2, "Comm" round(avg(mock.comm) * 10) / 10 tiny
    label 90, 78, "Tech" round(avg(mock.tech) * 10) / 10 tiny
    label 10, 78, "Solve" round(avg(mock.solve) * 10) / 10 tiny
section "Overall score over time"
  trend mock sort at, (it.comm + it.tech + it.solve) / 3

app "Parcel Desk" package ocean
table parcel track text, receiver text, city text, status pick Booked|In_transit|Out_for_delivery|Delivered|Returned = Booked
state st text = ""
topbar parcel, "Take parcel"
row gap 1
  each options parcel.status
    button it count(parcel where status = it) fill if(st = it, accent, soft) tap set st = if(st = it, "", it)
each parcel where st = "" or status = st sort at desc as p empty "No parcels here. Take the next one."
  row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
    stack grow gap 0
      p.receiver bold
      p.track "-" p.city faint
    if p.status = Booked
      button "Dispatch" tap set p.status = In_transit
    if p.status = In_transit
      button "Out" tap set p.status = Out_for_delivery
    if p.status = Out_for_delivery
      button "Delivered" tap set p.status = Delivered
    if p.status = Delivered or p.status = Returned
      p.status faint

    r.at grow
    tot(r) bold
    band(tot(r)) faint

    row gap 1

app "Mobile shop" phone plum
table accessory name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, expires date?
state q text = ""

field q "Search"
each accessory where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow

      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1

table evt name text, day date
table rsvp evt ref evt, who text, going pick Yes|Maybe|No = Yes

topbar evt, "Add event"
field me "Your name"
each evt where day >= today sort day as e empty "No events coming up. Plan something fun."
  stack card gap 1 swipe remove e
    row gap 1
      e.name bold grow
      e.day "·" e.day - today "days to go" faint
    row gap 2
      each options rsvp.going as g
        stack gap 0 align center grow
          count(e.rsvp where going = g) big
          g tiny faint
    if len(me) > 0
      row gap 1
        each options rsvp.going as g
          button g grow tap add rsvp evt = e, who = me, going = g

app "Books for sale" book plum
table title_stock name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3, price money?, kind pick Home|Work|Other
state q text = ""
let short = count(title_stock, it.qty <= it.low)
short "books running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each title_stock where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(title_stock, it.qty * it.price) faint
form title_stock

program_before:
app "My Tiffin" food mint
table customer name text
table order customer ref customer, meal pick Lunch|Dinner = Lunch, price money, delivery money = 0
row gap 2
  stat sum(order.price week), "income this week"
  stat sum(order.delivery week), "delivery cost"
  stat sum(order.price week) - sum(order.delivery week), "profit"
"Today's orders" head
each order today as o
  row card
    o.customer.name bold grow
    o.meal
    o.price
"Customers this week" head
each customer as c
  let pr = sum(c.order.price week) - sum(c.order.delivery week)
  row card gap 1 fill if(pr > 0 and pr = max(customer, sum(it.order.price week) - sum(it.order.delivery week)), good, surface)
    c.name bold grow
    count(c.order week) "orders"
    pr bold
    button "+ Lunch" tap add order customer = c, meal = Lunch, price = last(c.order.price)
form customer, "Add customer"
form order, "Add order"
